title: Lead Generation & Research Specialist
description:
Lead Generation & Research Specialist

(Remote · Full-time or Part-time · Long-term)



**READ THIS BEFORE YOU APPLY**



We get a LOT of applications, and we only read the ones from people who actually read the post. So here is your tiny test (you've got this):



1. Start your application with the word **Luminate**

2. In one sentence, tell us one type of company we do NOT want as a lead. The answer is hiding somewhere in this post. ????



No code word, no answer? Straight to the "maybe next time" pile. We promise we still think you're lovely.



---



**Who We Are**



Luminate Productions is a Belgian marketing growth partner for AI-first B2B companies. We help founders who already have a live AI product win their first 1.000 paying customers through smart, AI-driven marketing systems.



We're small, fast, and a little obsessed with doing things properly. You'd be one of our first hires, working directly with the founder. If you love clean systems, sharp research, and watching your work turn into real results (not just a spreadsheet nobody opens), you're going to feel right at home here.



No corporate stiffness. No "per my last
." Just good work, good energy, and good results.



**The Role**



We're looking for a Lead Generation & Research Specialist to build and qualify our list of dream clients. You'll hunt down the right companies, check whether they actually fit our criteria, and enrich each lead with everything we need before we reach out.



This is the engine room of our sales process. Great leads in means great clients out. We need someone precise, curious, and reliable. Someone who would rather hand over 20 perfect leads than 500 random ones and a shrug.



A few practical things:



- Full-time or part-time, depending on the right person

- Long-term role with room to scale into a full lead generation role, including outreach, across Europe and eventually the world. Start with the list, grow into the whole machine.



**What You Will Do**



- Find AI-first B2B companies in Belgium and the Netherlands that match our ideal client profile

- Work inside LinkedIn Sales Navigator to build the list, mark who is a qualified lead, and move them into HubSpot or our list-building sheet

- Qualify each company against a clear scorecard we give you (team size, revenue, industry, and more, all spelled out for you)

- Check each company's financial health on companyweb.be: look at the ARR, the numbers, and whether the company is healthy or waving little red flags

- Enrich each lead: founder name, LinkedIn URL, company website,
, team size

- A lot of companies are Dutch-speaking, so now and then you'll need to translate a page or two to check whether they're a real fit (Google Translate is totally fine)

- Keep everything tidy in the spreadsheet or CRM: no duplicates, no missing fields, no chaos

- Flag the strongest-fit leads so the founder knows exactly where to aim first



**Who We Want As Leads (and Who We Really Don't)**



So you know what you're hunting for, here's our dream company:



- AI-first businesses AND IT-automation companies with room to grow beyond their borders, internationally

- Small teams (roughly 1 to 10 people), based in Belgium or the Netherlands

- Funded or with early revenue, run by a founder who isn't afraid to be visible



Want the full checklist? We've put all the exact criteria right here, so you have them from minute one:





And here's who we do NOT want (yes, this is the answer to question 2 up top, you're welcome):



- Cybersecurity companies

- Odoo-implementation companies

- Hospitality or staffing businesses

- Companies with no real product yet, or big companies that already have their own marketing team



**About You**



- Excellent written English

- Sharp research skills and the kind of attention to detail where you double-check your own work before anyone asks

- Comfortable with LinkedIn, Sales Navigator, Google Sheets, and digging up company info online

- Experience with lead generation, list building, or research for an agency is a BIG plus

- Friendly with AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude) to move faster, while still checking the facts yourself, because robots get it wrong too

- A self-starter who's reliable, organised, and communicates clearly



**What To Expect**



- A fast, friendly, no-bullshit working environment

- Direct contact with the founder and crystal-clear instructions

- A proper scorecard and process, so you're never left guessing

- Steady work and a real chance to grow with us as we sign more clients



**How To Apply**



Still here? Love that! Here's your task. Keep it short and sharp, we care about quality, not word count.



Your task:



1. Find 5 companies you think match our ideal client profile (check the criteria google doc above)

2. For each one, give us: company name, website, founder name, LinkedIn URL, and one sentence on WHY it's a good fit

3. Add ONE company that looks like a fit but actually isn't, and tell us why not (this is the fun part, and the one that tells us you really get it)



Pop your answer in a Google Sheet or simple doc and share the link.



And remember: start your message with the code word and answer the NOT-a-fit question at the top. Those are the first things we look for. ????

* Organize
s and project communications

title: Sales Development Representative (SDR) – Lead Qualification Specialist
description:
Sales Development Representative (SDR) – Lead Qualification Specialist 



Compensation: $500-$800 USD per month 



Location:Remote (Philippines) 



About the Role 

We are seeking a highly organized and confident Sales Development Representative (SDR) to 

manage inbound leads, conduct discovery calls, qualify prospects, and maintain CRM accuracy. 

This is not a closing role. Your primary responsibility is to identify qualified business owners, 

gather key information through consultative conversations, and move qualified prospects to the 

next stage of the sales process. 

You will serve as the first point of contact for prospective clients and play a critical role in 

maintaining a healthy sales pipeline. 



Key Responsibilities 

Lead Qualification & Discovery 

• Review new leads entering the CRM. 

• Analyze lead forms and background information before outreach. 

• Conduct outbound qualification calls with prospective clients. 

• Build rapport and guide prospects through a structured discovery conversation. 

• Determine fit using the BANT framework: 

o Budget 

o Authority 

o Need 

o Timeline 

CRM Management 

• Maintain accurate and detailed CRM records. 

• Document business size, employee count, training needs, and budget information. 

• Update lead statuses and pipeline stages promptly. 

Pipeline Coordination 

• Route qualified prospects to the sales closer/strategist. 

• Tag and organize unqualified leads for long-term nurture campaigns. 

• Ensure all lead information is complete before handoff. 

Daily Operations 

• Monitor CRM pipelines daily. 

• Follow up on assigned leads and scheduled appointments. 

• Maintain pipeline hygiene and data accuracy. 

Required Qualifications 

• Excellent spoken English with a neutral accent. 

• Minimum 2 years of experience in: 

o SDR 

o Appointment Setting 

o Lead Generation 

o Call Center/BPO 

o Inside Sales 

• Experience conducting outbound and inbound phone conversations. 

• Strong CRM experience (HubSpot, Salesforce, GoHighLevel, ActiveCampaign, or similar). 

• Comfortable discussing business metrics, company size, and budget allocation with 

business owners. 

• Reliable home office setup: 

o Minimum 25 Mbps internet 

o Noise-canceling headset 

o Quiet workspace 

o Backup internet and power solution 



Preferred Qualifications 

• Experience working with coaching, consulting, or corporate training companies. 

• Experience supporting US, UK, or Australian businesses. 

• Familiarity with qualification frameworks such as BANT. 

• Skilled in politely disqualifying prospects who are not a fit. 



Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) 

• 100% of new leads reviewed and actioned within 2 hours. 

• 40–50 outbound qualification calls per day. 

• Accurate CRM documentation and pipeline updates. 

• Minimum 25% lead qualification rate. 

• Consistent handoff of qualified prospects to the sales team. 



Ideal Candidate 

You are confident on the phone, naturally curious, highly organized, and comfortable speaking 

with business owners. You enjoy asking discovery questions, uncovering needs, and determining 

whether a prospect is a strong fit before passing them to a closer. 

If you thrive in a structured sales environment and enjoy building pipelines rather than closing 

deals, we'd love to hear from you.

________________________________________

Application Process

Please include:

• Short summary of your experience in cold calling or lead generation 

• Any relevant SDR, telemarketing, or BPO experience 

• Tools or CRM systems you have used (if any) 

• Brief note on your comfort level with outbound calling

title: Graphic Designer
description:
ABOUT SCRIVEINER LONDON

Scriveiner is an award-winning British luxury brand specialising in writing instruments and premium accessories.

Founded in 2019, our products are used by millions of customers worldwide, available via major online marketplaces and from more than 1,000 retail stores around the globe. Our mission is simple: to create beautiful, high-quality products that people love to use every day.

The company has grown rapidly and has been recognised with numerous awards, including the King’s Award for Enterprise, The Sunday Times 100, the Great British Entrepreneur Awards, and multiple international design awards.

Scriveiner is the flagship brand of Infinity Brands, a founder-led business focused on building premium consumer brands with global reach. We are high-growth, entrepreneurial and hands-on, and we are focused on delivering exceptional products and customer experiences.







THE OPPORTUNITY

At Scriveiner, design is not decoration. It is the product. From the curve of a pen to the layout of a product listing, every visual decision is an expression of what this brand stands for. Our customers have awarded us five product design awards. Our peers have recognised us with the King’s Award for Enterprise. The bar is not aspirational. It is already set.

We are now hiring a Graphic Designer to own the visual output of the business: everything from Amazon A+ content and Shopify imagery to packaging, print materials, and retail partner assets. This is a broad, hands-on role with real creative ownership, not a production queue role where someone else makes the decisions and you execute.

Scriveiner operates and sells globally, and as the brand expands into new markets and product categories, the volume and variety of design work will grow with it. If you want to build a genuine body of work at a brand people notice, this is where to do it.







WHAT YOU WILL OWN

Own the visual quality of every digital and physical asset Scriveiner ships: product listing images, A+ content, social graphics, packaging, print materials, and retail partner assets.

Design and maintain product listing imagery for Shopify and Amazon, ensuring all assets meet platform specifications, convert effectively, and are unmistakably on-brand.

Create Amazon A+ content modules including enhanced brand sections, comparison charts, and lifestyle image layouts that drive both conversion and brand perception.

Produce and adapt assets for retail partners, interpreting co-branding briefs and working within third-party templates without compromising brand standards.

Own packaging artwork from concept to print-ready files, coordinating with suppliers and production teams to ensure accurate, on-time delivery.

Design product manuals, inserts, and printed materials to the same standard as the product itself: clear, precise, and on-brand.

Build and maintain a library of reusable social templates across Instagram,
, LinkedIn, and YouTube to enable faster, more consistent content production.

Perform light retouching on product photography and provide simple video editing support as required.

Maintain an organised, versioned asset library so all final files are accessible and correctly named.







WHO YOU ARE

Essential — you must have this

A strong portfolio demonstrating ecommerce and product-focused design work. Amazon, Shopify, or D2C experience is expected.

Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign) and Figma.

A precise eye for detail and a genuine intolerance for off-brand, low-quality output.

Ability to manage multiple briefs simultaneously, prioritise effectively, and hit deadlines without being chased.

Experience designing for both digital screens and print or physical production, with an understanding of file preparation and production specs.

Commercial awareness: you understand how design influences conversion and make decisions with that in mind, not just aesthetics.

AI-literate and comfortable using tools to work more efficiently without compromising craft.



Desirable — it would strengthen your application if you have

Experience within a premium, lifestyle, gifting, or consumer goods brand where brand standards are non-negotiable.

Familiarity with Amazon A+ content and product listing image best practices.

Basic photo retouching and video editing skills using Adobe Lightroom, Premiere, or similar.

Exposure to packaging design and working directly with print suppliers or production teams.

Experience producing retail partner assets and adapting brand materials to third-party templates.







WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

In this role, you will be successful when:

Every product listing image and A+ module is visually compelling, accurate, and consistent with brand standards.

Social and thumbnail assets are produced on time and require minimal revision.

Packaging and manual artwork is delivered print-ready, with zero production errors.

Retail partner asset requests are turned around quickly and to brief.

The creative output of the business looks unmistakably like Scriveiner, everywhere.







KEY WORKING RELATIONSHIPS

Head of Marketing: your primary brief-giver. You translate their direction into finished visual assets and raise blockers early.

Marketing & Ecommerce team: collaborate on asset requirements for campaigns, product launches, and retailer activations.

Retail partners: receive and interpret co-branding briefs and partner asset requirements.

External suppliers and print partners: manage file handover, proofing, and production sign-off.





HOW TO APPLY

title: CREATING STRATEGIST - DTC ECOM UP TO 5K USD/MO
description:
Hiring DTC - ECOM CREATIVE STRATEGIST

Remote | Full-Time | Meta Ads Focus | Restricted Categories



About Growing Pains Marketing



Growing Pains Marketing is a performance marketing agency focused on scaling DTC eCommerce brands through paid social, creative strategy, and direct response advertising.



We specialize in Meta ads and work with brands in competitive and often restricted categories, including wellness, supplements, CBD-adjacent products, telemedicine, research compounds, and other markets where strong creative strategy, compliance awareness, and fast execution matter.



We are looking for a DTC eCommerce Creative Strategist who understands Meta ads inside and out, can turn research into strong creative briefs, and can help launch, monitor, and improve ad creative across multiple client accounts.



This is not just a “make pretty ads” role.



We need someone who can think strategically, understand customer psychology, study competitors, identify winning angles, write strong briefs, collaborate with designers/editors/UGC creators, and help us consistently produce ads that drive purchases.



Role Overview



As our Creative Strategist, you will be responsible for researching markets, developing creative angles, writing briefs, coordinating creative production, uploading/launching ads in Meta, and monitoring performance to identify what is working.



You should be comfortable working across multiple DTC eCommerce accounts and moving quickly without sacrificing strategy or quality.



You will work closely with media buyers, designers, video editors, UGC creators, and leadership to ensure each account has a strong pipeline of new creative.



Key Responsibilities:

Creative Strategy



Develop creative strategies for DTC eCommerce brands running Meta ads.



Research customer avatars, pain points, desires, objections, competitor positioning, reviews, Reddit threads, TikTok trends, Meta Ad Library, Amazon reviews, landing pages, and customer language.



Identify new hooks, angles, offers, formats, and messaging opportunities.



Create clear creative testing plans based on performance data and market research.



Understand direct response principles, buyer psychology, and how to structure ads that convert.



Creative Briefs



Write detailed creative briefs for designers, video editors, and UGC creators.



Include hooks, concepts, scripts, visual direction, claims/compliance notes, CTA, product positioning, and references.



Make sure briefs are specific enough that the creative team can execute without confusion.



Provide examples of winning ads, swipe files, and references when needed.



Meta Ads Execution



Upload, launch, and organize ads inside Meta Ads Manager.



Understand Meta campaign structure, ad sets, ad naming conventions, creative testing, and basic performance monitoring.



Know how to read creative performance inside Meta and identify winners, losers, and patterns.



Work with media buyers to understand what creative needs to be tested next.



Monitor active ads and help determine when creative needs to be paused, iterated, or scaled.



Creative Performance Analysis



Review ad performance by hook, angle, format, offer, product, audience, and creative type.



Identify why certain ads are working or not working.



Use performance data to inform future creative briefs.



Track winning patterns across accounts.



Help build a repeatable creative testing system.



Client-Facing Communication



Communicate clearly and professionally with clients when needed.



Present creative strategies, explain why certain angles are being tested, and provide updates on creative direction.



Strong written and spoken English is required.



You must be able to explain your thinking clearly on calls, in Slack, and in Loom videos.



Requirements



You must have experience with DTC eCommerce creative strategy.



You must understand Meta ads deeply, especially for purchase/conversion campaigns.



You must be able to upload, launch, and monitor ads inside Meta Ads Manager.



You must know how to create creative briefs that designers, editors, and UGC creators can actually execute.



You must understand customer research, competitor research, and offer positioning.



You must have excellent written and spoken English.



You must be comfortable recording Loom videos explaining your strategy.



You must be organized, fast, and able to manage multiple accounts.



You must be comfortable working with restricted or compliance-sensitive categories.



You must be available during some U.S. working hours. Between 6-9 am and 3-5 PM depending on your starting shift.



We are not hiring candidates located in North America, or citizens of North America for this role.



Nice to Have



Experience with CBD, supplements, peptides, telemedicine, health/wellness, or other restricted categories.



Experience sourcing or managing UGC creators.



Experience writing UGC scripts.



Experience with tools like Triple Whale, Motion, Foreplay, Meta Ad Library, TikTok Creative Center, Shopify, or GoHighLevel.



Experience working inside an agency.



Compensation



Base pay: $1,500–$3,000 USD per month, depending on experience and skill level.



Bonus: $100/month per account that maintains KPI on a monthly basis.



Expected account load: 10–20 accounts per month.



If you are able to handle more accounts while maintaining quality, that is a plus.



Hiring Process:



Step 1: Application



You will complete the application questions below and submit examples of your previous work.



Step 2: Level 1 Test



If your application looks strong, we will send you a short Level 1 creative strategy test.



Step 3: Interview



If your Level 1 test is strong, we will schedule an interview.



Step 4: Level 2 Test



Final candidates will complete a paid, more advanced creative strategy test before an offer is made.



Application Requirements



Please answer the questions below carefully. Generic answers will not be considered.



You must also include a Loom video under 5 minutes explaining your experience and walking us through how you think about creative strategy.



Application Questions



Experience

How many years of experience do you have with DTC eCommerce creative strategy?



What types of products or industries have you created ad strategies for?



Have you worked with Meta ads specifically? Explain your experience with campaign setup, ad launching, and performance monitoring.



Creative Strategy

Walk us through your process for going from product research to creative angles.



What makes a strong Meta ad creative for a DTC eCommerce brand?



Share 2–3 examples of creative briefs you have personally created. Include links or screenshots if possible.



Research Process

What sources do you use when researching customers, competitors, and ad angles?



How do you find customer pain points, objections, and buying triggers?



Give an example of a time your research led to a winning ad angle.



Performance Analysis

What metrics do you look at when judging whether an ad creative is working?



How do you d
 whether to kill, iterate, or scale a creative?



Give an example of an ad that failed and what you learned from it.



Communication

This is a client-facing role. How comfortable are you explaining creative strategy to clients?



You MUST include a Loom video under 5 minutes introducing yourself and explaining your creative strategy process.



Rate your spoken and written English from 1–10 and briefly explain.



Availability & Fit

What country and time zone are you located in?

Are you available to work some U.S. business hours?

What monthly compensation are you looking for in USD?



How to Apply



DO NOT MESSAGE ME ON ONLINEJOBS.PH

YOU MUST submit the following to 
 portfolio.



Examples of creative briefs you have created.



Examples of ads you helped strategize.



A Loom video under 5 minutes explaining your creative strategy process.



Answers to the application questions above.

title: Accounting Executive
description:
About Scriveiner

Scriveiner is an award-winning British luxury brand specialising in writing instruments and premium accessories. Founded in 2019, our products are used by millions of customers worldwide, available via major online marketplaces and from more than 1,000 retail stores around the globe. Our mission is simple: to create beautiful, high-quality products that people love to use every day.



The company has grown rapidly and has been recognised with numerous awards, including the King’s Award for Enterprise, The Sunday Times 100, the Great British Entrepreneur Awards, and multiple international design awards.



Scriveiner is the flagship brand of Infinity Brands, a founder-led business focused on building premium consumer brands with global reach. We are high-growth, entrepreneurial and hands-on, and we are focused on delivering exceptional products and customer experiences.





The Opportunity

Scriveiner is at a pivotal point in its growth expanding into new premium product categories, scaling its Amazon and Shopify channels, and building the operational infrastructure to support a significant step-change over the next three years. As the business grows, so does the need for a finance function that is not just accurate, but sharp.



We are hiring an Accounting Executive to sit at the operational core of the Finance team. This is a role for someone who understands UK accounting deeply, works confidently without a manual, and brings the kind of proactive judgment that means problems get spotted before they become problems. The Finance Manager is looking for someone who improves how the function works not just someone who keeps pace with it.



Day to day, you will own the transactional engine of the business: AP, AR, bank reconciliations, VAT, month-end close, and the accuracy behind every financial report we produce. But the expectation goes further than execution. You will look at how we do things, identify where they can be tighter, and take genuine ownership of the financial integrity of a lean, fast-moving business. The systems you help build now will underpin Scriveiner at twice its current size.



What You Will Own

Own the accuracy and completeness of daily financial transactions, AP, AR, invoicing, and payment runs ensuring every entry is correctly authorised, coded, and filed

Lead bank and supplier reconciliations, resolving discrepancies proactively rather than waiting for month-end to surface them

Take full ownership of VAT preparation and filing support, maintaining compliance with UK regulations

Drive month-end and year-end close activities, moving the process forward with minimal direction

Maintain clean audit trails across all financial records digital and physical so documentation is always ready, not assembled at the last minute

Identify gaps and inefficiencies in current financial processes and bring forward practical improvements you are expected to flag what is not working and suggest what should replace it

Support the preparation of management accounts, P&L summaries, cash flow reports, and balance sheet reconciliations that the Finance Manager and founders can rely on

Liaise with internal teams and external suppliers on financial queries, acting as a reliable point of contact who resolves issues without escalation

Contribute to forecasting and budgeting inputs as the business plans for growth across new product categories and marketplaces

Perform intercompany reconciliations, ensuring transactions between business entities are accurately recorded and resolved in a timely manner

Assist in the preparation of divisional profit and loss accounts, supporting clear visibility of performance across the business

Ensure correct expense allocation across business divisions, maintaining accuracy and consistency in how costs are assigned and reported





Who You Are

Essential — you must have this:

Solid, hands-on UK accounting experience you understand VAT, AP/AR workflows, reconciliations, and month-end close as second nature

Proven proficiency with at least one major accounting platform: Xero, QuickBooks, or Sage

Strong Excel skills: pivot tables, VLOOKUPs, and basic data modelling without needing to be shown

A track record of working independently, you manage your own workload, flag risks early, and do not require close supervision to maintain accuracy

A genuine drive to improve how a finance function works, not just maintain it  you notice inefficiencies and act on them

High attention to detail with a professional approach to confidentiality and financial data





Desirable — it would strengthen your application if you have this:

Familiarity with e-commerce accounting, particularly Amazon Seller Central or Shopify financial flows

Experience working in a small or scaling business where finance is a lean, high-ownership function

Exposure to multi-currency transactions or international marketplace accounting





What Success Looks Like

In this role, you will be successful when:

Financial records are consistently accurate, up to date, and audit-ready without prompting

Bank and supplier reconciliations are completed on time with discrepancies identified and resolved proactively

VAT filings and compliance obligations are met without error or delay

Month-end close is completed efficiently, with reports the Finance Manager and founders can rely on

You bring forward at least one meaningful improvement to financial processes or systems within your first 90 days

The Finance Manager spends less time checking and more time using the information you produce



HOW TO APPLY

title: Inventory Assistant
description:
ABOUT SCRIVEINER LONDON

Scriveiner is an award-winning British luxury brand specialising in writing instruments and premium accessories.

Founded in 2019, our products are used by millions of customers worldwide, available via major online marketplaces and from more than 1,000 retail stores around the globe. Our mission is simple: to create beautiful, high-quality products that people love to use every day.

The company has grown rapidly and has been recognised with numerous awards, including the King’s Award for Enterprise, The Sunday Times 100, the Great British Entrepreneur Awards, and multiple international design awards.

Scriveiner is the flagship brand of Infinity Brands, a founder-led business focused on building premium consumer brands with global reach. We are high-growth, entrepreneurial and hands-on, and we are focused on delivering exceptional products and customer experiences.





THE OPPORTUNITY

As Inventory Assistant, you will work at the operational heart of the Inventory team, keeping stock records accurate, Amazon FBA running cleanly, and our third-party logistics partners on track. This is not a passive role. You will be the person who catches discrepancies before they become customer problems, flags low stock before it becomes a lost sale, and ensures that every shipment entering or leaving the warehouse is accounted for correctly.



The role covers the full operational breadth of inventory management: from daily stock reconciliation across the IM Sheet and Power BI dashboards, to managing Amazon Seller Central shipments and processing FBA reimbursements, to coordinating with 3PL partners on inbound and outbound fulfilment. New product launches, including wallets, notebooks, and leather accessories targeting Q3 2026, will add meaningful scope and pace to the role over the coming months.



If you are someone who finds genuine satisfaction in a clean reconciliation, who catches errors others walk past, and who wants to understand how a premium e-commerce brand actually operates end-to-end, this role will give you exactly that.





WHAT YOU WILL OWN

Stock Management and Control

Maintain accurate, up-to-date inventory records across the IM Sheet, Power BI dashboards, and all active e-commerce platforms — these records are the operational source of truth for the business

Update and manage stock levels on the Faire and Turis wholesale platforms, ensuring availability is always reflected correctly for trade buyers

Conduct regular cycle counts, spot checks, and full stocktakes; investigate and resolve discrepancies, variances, and shrinkage before they escalate

Monitor stock levels proactively and flag low-inventory or overstock situations to the Inventory Manager



Order Management and 3PL Coordination

Import and process orders into 3PL partner systems, double-checking previous orders for unfulfilled or incomplete items

Prepare and coordinate retail orders for dispatch, liaising with 3PL partners to ensure timely and accurate fulfilment

Process incoming shipments from suppliers and freight carriers, verifying quantities and quality, resolving delivery discrepancies, and updating stock records accurately



Amazon Seller Central and FBA Operations

Create and manage Amazon FBA shipments end-to-end in Seller Central, including video verification, status tracking, and updating the Shipment Status File

Process FBA reimbursement claims for missing or lost units, maintaining accurate dispute records



Reporting and Compliance

Prepare and distribute the OD Weekly Report; update, file, and manage OD dispute records for compliance charges and discrepancies

Generate inventory reports and variance summaries using the IM Sheet and Power BI

Support the Inventory Manager with inventory data for seasonal demand forecasting and buying decisions

Perform other ad hoc tasks as directed by the Inventory Manager or wider Operations team



WHO YOU ARE

Essential

Hands-on experience in an inventory, warehousing, or retail operations role — you have worked with stock, reconciled records, and managed order processes in a real operational environment

Confident working with inventory management tools and reporting platforms, whether that is a WMS, ERP, IM Sheet, or Power BI in combination

Practical experience with Amazon Seller Central and FBA processes, including shipment creation and account management

Strong numerical accuracy and attention to detail — you catch errors in data that others overlook, and you find reconciliation satisfying rather than tedious

Competent in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets for reporting, data management, and variance analysis

A proactive communicator who flags issues early rather than waiting to be asked



Desirable

Experience with wholesale platforms such as Faire and/or Turis

Familiarity with 3PL order management, fulfilment workflows, and inbound shipment processing

Experience handling Amazon compliance charges, disputes, and FBA reimbursement claims

Understanding of FIFO stock rotation principles and inventory control best practices

Experience using AI tools to improve operational workflows or reporting efficiency





WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

In this role, you will be successful when:

Inventory records across all platforms are accurate and current, with discrepancies investigated and resolved promptly.

Amazon FBA shipments are created, verified, and tracked without errors, and reimbursement claims are filed on time.

3PL orders are processed accurately, with fulfilment issues identified and escalated before they affect customers.

The OD Weekly Report and compliance records are maintained consistently and without prompting.

The Inventory Manager can rely on your data to make confident stock and buying decisions.

Production & Editorial Team

New hire - this role

Systems & Software

AI Animation Tools (chosen and managed by the specialist)

-3D Animation & Rendering software (for brand idents)

title: Amazon Product Dev and Sourcing Specialist (Private Label | China Suppliers | 3+ Years)
description:
Who We Are

BTS Brands is an 8-year-old private label company selling across US, CA, UK, EU, AU, JP and expanding into Saudi Arabia. We operate across two brands - one in the travel accessories category and one in beauty devices - with 52+ active SKUs.



We're not a startup figuring things out - we have systems, a team, and a clear direction. What we need now is someone senior who can take full ownership of product development for one of our brands while we scale.



The Role

This is not a VA role. This is a specialist position for someone who has done this before and can work independently.

You will own the full product lifecycle for one brand: from identifying opportunities, to negotiating with Chinese suppliers on WeChat, to making sure samples, timelines, packaging, and user manuals are all on track before launch. You'll also do product research for our second brand.

You'll work closely with our marketing and design team, and report directly to the owner.



What You'll Do Daily:

- Conduct product research across Amazon marketplaces (US/CA/UK/EU/AU/JP)

- Analyze competition, demand, pricing, and profitability (ROI, FBA fees, net margin)

- Communicate directly with Chinese suppliers via WeChat - negotiate pricing, MOQs, timelines

- Request and evaluate samples, coordinate quality checks

- Monitor production timelines and flag delays before they become problems

- Review packaging and user manuals for compliance (not copy, just accuracy)

- Calculate profitability at every stage before committing to a launch

- Collaborate with marketing and graphic design teams on launch prep

- Report weekly with recommendations and progress updates



Tools You Must Know:

- Helium 10 (Cerebro, Black Box, Xray, Keyword Tracker)

- Keepa - price history, trends, seasonality

- Amazon Seller Central - BSR, sales data interpretation

- Alibaba + WeChat - supplier sourcing and negotiation

- Google Sheets / Excel - ROI models, dashboards, profitability trackers

- Jungle Scout - a plus



 Who We're Looking For:

- 3–5 years experience in Amazon Private Label product development and sourcing

- You've negotiated directly with Chinese suppliers - not just browsed Alibaba

- You think in numbers: margins, costs, lead times, risks

- You communicate clearly in English, written and verbal

- You're organized and proactive - you chase timelines, you don't wait to be chased

- You want a long-term role with room to grow, not a short contract



Compensation & Setup:

- $1,000–$1,400/month based on experience

- Full-time, 40h/week

- 14 days paid leave after 3 months

- First 3 months: time-tracked via Time Doctor (removed after we establish trust) 

- Long-term position - We Invest in People Who Invest in Us



Important

This role is for one of our brands that currently has no team. You'll be building from the ground up with clear direction from ownership. If you need someone to micromanage your daily tasks, this isn't the right fit. If you thrive with clear objectives and autonomy, keep reading.





To Apply - Required

Answer these 4 questions. Applications without answers will not be considered:



1. Describe a product you sourced from a Chinese supplier,  how did you find them, how did you negotiate, and what was the final outcome? Include the platform you used to find them (Alibaba, WeChat, trade show etc.), the MOQ you negotiated, and one specific thing that almost went wrong. Do not describe what you would do - describe what you actually did.

2. Walk me through your evaluation process for a Private Label product - what metrics matter most to you, what makes you say no, and what makes you say yes? Give a real example without naming the product. What's your process, not your tools.

3. What tools do you use daily for Amazon product research, and rate your confidence in each from 1 to 10. For the tool you rated highest - walk me through one specific thing you do in it that most people skip or don't know about.

4. What's the biggest mistake you've seen (or made) in product development, and what did you change after? Be specific.

title: Marketing Assistant
description:
ABOUT SCRIVEINER LONDON

Scriveiner is an award-winning British luxury brand specialising in writing instruments and premium accessories.

Founded in 2019, our products are used by millions of customers worldwide, available via major online marketplaces and from more than 1,000 retail stores around the globe. Our mission is simple: to create beautiful, high-quality products that people love to use every day.

The company has grown rapidly and has been recognised with numerous awards, including the King’s Award for Enterprise, The Sunday Times 100, the Great British Entrepreneur Awards, and multiple international design awards.

Scriveiner is the flagship brand of Infinity Brands, a founder-led business focused on building premium consumer brands with global reach. We are high-growth, entrepreneurial and hands-on, and we are focused on delivering exceptional products and customer experiences.







THE OPPORTUNITY

Scriveiner is entering its next chapter: building from a well-established, award-winning brand into a globally recognised name in accessible luxury. New markets, new product ranges, and a rapidly growing direct and retail footprint mean the business needs people who are as good at building systems as they are at running them.

The Marketing & Ecommerce Assistant is the connective tissue of our marketing and commercial operations. This is the role that keeps the engine running: ensuring the Shopify catalogue is flawless, the retailer pipeline is active and accurately tracked, and the weekly reporting tells a clear, actionable story. It is not a support role. It is an ownership role.

Scriveiner operates and sells globally, and as the brand expands into new markets, the coordination and localisation demands of this role will grow with it





WHAT YOU WILL OWN

Own the Shopify catalogue end to end: product uploads, descriptions, imagery, pricing, tagging, and collections, with a zero-tolerance standard for accuracy across all live listings in every active market.

Keep the retailer outreach tracker live and current across all regions, logging every conversation, follow-up, and next action so no pipeline relationship goes cold.

Produce the weekly ecommerce report autonomously, without prompting, delivering clean, action-oriented performance data that the business can act on immediately.

Coordinate new market and product launch asset production, managing timelines, briefing designers and translators, and ensuring all creative and localisation requirements land ahead of launch windows with zero gaps.

Draft and send trade communications to prospective and existing retail partners across all active territories, written to Scriveiner brand standards, not to a template.

Build and maintain ecommerce dashboards that give real, useful visibility into what is working and what needs attention.

Flag risks and anomalies proactively: Shopify discrepancies, performance dips, asset gaps, or retailer conversations going cold, before they become problems that need escalation.







WHO YOU ARE

Essential — you must have this

Hands-on Shopify experience: you have managed a live store and understand catalogue management, product uploads, pricing, and data accuracy in practice, not just in theory.

Organisational ability that closes loops without prompting. You track your own work, know what is outstanding, and get things finished.

Confidence with data: comfortable building dashboards, maintaining trackers, and presenting performance in a way that tells a clear story.

Strong written English, capable of drafting trade communications and brand-consistent copy that does not need a round of editing before it goes out.

Ability to manage several concurrent workstreams across different markets without losing detail in any of them.

AI-literate and comfortable using tools, whether for writing, reporting, or workflow automation, to work more efficiently.



Desirable — it would strengthen your application if you have

Experience in wholesale, retail account management, or trade marketing. You understand how retailer relationships work in practice.

Exposure to multi-market or international marketing operations, including asset localisation and translation management.

Background in a premium, lifestyle, or gifting brand where attention to presentation and brand standards is non-negotiable.

Experience using analytics platforms beyond spreadsheets: Shopify analytics, Google Analytics, or similar.







WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

The Shopify catalogue is 100?curate at all times across every active market: every product live, correctly described, correctly priced.

title: Creative Strategist
description:
About the company

At Miraco Nutripharm, we are dedicated to advancing health & improving lives. Our goal is to relieve 1 billion people worldwide of pain & discomfort. If you know of anyone who has been worried about or suffered from any health problems, join us in making a positive impact by reducing the pain & distress others have to endure.



Job description

We're looking for a Creative Strategist & Content Producer to shape how our health & pharmaceutical brands communicate across both digital & offline channels. You'll craft effective strategies that translate scientific credibility into compelling storytelling & creative assets - helping us engage our diverse audience as we expand our presence regionally. 



The Creative Strategist & Content Producer will be the visionary link between our brand identity, compelling content creation & drive measurable performance across all key channels. This role is responsible for developing & testing high-impact creative strategies as well as producing content assets (visual, video, copy) internally, specifically designed to drive traffic, increase conversion rates, lower Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) & drive overall revenue growth for our Shopify, Shopee & Lazada stores via social media as well as paid advertising platforms.



You'll work across multiple channels & markets to plan, create & optimize content that builds awareness, strengthens partnerships & supports the new channels of the business. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys balancing creativity, analytics & brand strategy in the health supplement industry. 



Key Responsibilities:

Creative Strategy

- Platform & Channel Strategy: Craft tailored creative strategies for B2C & B2B audiences optimized for platform-specific best practices & formats that align with brand goals & regulatory requirements in each market (e.g., Meta carousel ads, vertical video for TikTok/Reels, static product carousels for Shopee/Lazada e-commerce banner ads).

- Hypothesis Generation & A/B Testing: Develop robust creative testing matrices, formulate clear hypotheses for creative elements (hooks, calls-to-action, visual styles, copy length) that drive measurable improvements in Click-Through Rate (CTR) & Conversion Rate (CVR).

- Audience Segmentation: Translate target audience data & segmentation provided by media buyers into resonant creative themes, ensuring content speaks directly to different stages of the marketing funnel (awareness, consideration, conversion).

- Competitive Analysis: Continuously keep up to date with competitors & industry trends, identifying new & successful creative formats, hooks & messaging to finetune our strategy.

In-House Content Production & Execution 

- Performance Creative Development: Lead the end-to-end creative concept development & production for all organic & paid media campaigns (Meta, TikTok, Google/YouTube, etc.) that align with brand & campaign goals, focusing on high-volume, quick-turnaround testing required for performance marketing.

- Hands-on Asset Creation: Directly produce & edit native social content & performance ads using existing assets, stock libraries & internal resources. This includes:

i. Plan platform-specific content calendars: Cover educational, promotional & corporate communications

ii. Static/Image Editing: Adapt product photography, create ad variations & design simple graphics & banner ads

iii. Video Editing: Fast-paced assembly, cutting, adding text overlays, music & effects for short-form, vertical video (UGC-style, product demos, testimonials)

- Copywriting: Develop high-converting ad copy, landing page headlines & social media captions that align with the creative strategy & brand voice, with a focus on clear value propositions & strong CTAs.

- Asset Management: Ensure all campaign assets are correctly tagged, archived & deployed across relevant channels (Shopify, Shopee, Lazada store fronts & advertising platforms).

- Testing & Optimization: apply insights & analytics to refine & optimize content effectiveness across platforms.

Performance & Reporting

- Data-Driven Insights: Work closely with the Marketing Manager to analyze creative performance reports, identifying which creative variables are driving results (or failing) across Shopify, Shopee & Lazada traffic.

- Iteration & Optimization: 

i. Develop, adapt or review content & formats to improve engagement & performance

ii. Use performance data (ROAS, CPA, CTR, CVR) to rapidly iterate on existing creative assets & inform future strategy, ensuring a continuous cycle of improvement & optimization

Storefront Integration: Integrate winning creative messages & visuals onto the respective e-commerce storefronts (product pages, banners) to ensure a cohesive customer journey.

Multi-Channel Storytelling

- Content cohesion: Ensure content is aligned where possible across digital & print media, including LinkedIn, Instagram,
, YouTube, e-commerce platforms, brochures & trade materials.

- Tailor content: To achieve relevance & effectiveness across different stages of the audience journey — from brand awareness & education to conversion.

- Storytelling & visual consistency: To strengthen brand trust & recognition.

Compliance & Brand Integrity

- Uphold regulatory & ethical communication standards across all marketing activities.

Project teams

 click tracking

title: Shopify Store Builder and Product Listing Manager | GMC Approval and Ongoing Catalog Management
description:
**Shopify Store Builder and Product Listing Manager | GMC Approval and Ongoing Catalog Management**



---



We are launching a new ecommerce store and we need someone who can build it the right way from the start. Not just a good looking store but one that is structured correctly to get approved by Google Merchant Center so we can start selling through Google Shopping. Once the store is live and approved the role shifts into ongoing catalog management where you will be adding products and keeping everything accurate and up to date every single day.



This is a long term full time role. The right person will own this store from build to approval to daily operations.



---



**Phase one — Building the store**



You will build our Shopify store from scratch. That means setting up the theme, homepage, collections, navigation, product pages, and all the essential pages like about, contact, refund policy, privacy policy, and terms of service. Everything needs to be clean, mobile friendly, and on brand for a home decor audience.



More importantly everything needs to be structured correctly for Google Merchant Center from day one. That means accurate product titles, descriptions, images, pricing, GTINs, and all required attributes. Shipping and return policies need to meet GMC requirements. The store needs to pass GMC review without issues.



You will also set up the Google Merchant Center account, connect it to Shopify, configure the product feed, and make sure everything syncs correctly and cleanly.



---



**Phase two — Ongoing catalog management**



Once the store is live and GMC approved the role becomes about keeping the catalog growing and accurate. You will be adding new products regularly, updating existing listings, maintaining image quality, and making sure nothing falls out of GMC compliance over time. We expect around 50 products processed within a 2.5 hour window at a consistently high standard.



You will also build out new collection pages and theme sections as the catalog grows, run regular audits to catch errors or disapprovals before they become problems, and keep inventory levels accurate and organized.



---



**What we need from you**



You have built a Shopify store from scratch before and you understand what it takes to get it right the first time. You know Google Merchant Center inside and out. You know what causes disapprovals, how to fix them, and how to structure a store so it passes review cleanly. You are fast and accurate with product listings. Speed without accuracy does not work in this role. You have a strong eye for visual detail. You care about how the store looks and you can tell when something feels off brand. You use AI tools like Gemini and ChatGPT daily to speed up your workflow without sacrificing quality. You can work independently once you understand our standards.



---



**Experience that will move you to the top of the list**



You have successfully gotten a Shopify store approved on Google Merchant Center before. You have managed a large product catalog with hundreds of SKUs. You have experience using Gemini specifically for generating product images that feel consistent and branded rather than generic or stock looking. You have used Kopy or a similar tool for writing and optimizing product listings. Home decor, beauty, health, or lifestyle brand experience is a strong plus.



---



**Tools you should know or be ready to learn fast**



Shopify for store builds and product management. Google Merchant Center for feed setup, compliance, and account management. Gemini for AI product image generation. Kopy or similar for listing copy and optimization. ChatGPT or any AI tool for descriptions and workflow. Canva or Photoshop for image editing and visual cleanup.



---



**How we work**



We will onboard you into our brand standards, product requirements, and what good looks like for us. After that you own the store completely from the technical setup to the daily listing work. We have high standards but we do not micromanage. We expect clean work, consistent output, and clear communication.



---



**How to apply**



Tell us about a Shopify store you built from scratch. If you have gotten a store approved on Google Merchant Center tell us about that specifically — what you set up, what issues came up, and how you resolved them. Share examples of product listings you have created or optimized. Tell us how many products you can list per hour at a high standard. Tell us which AI tools you use and how you use them. If you have used Gemini for product image generation tell us about that.



Generic applications will not be considered. Specific ones with real examples will get a fast response.

This is a low base-pay, high-upside role. The real money is in commission — every product sale you help generate earns you $5. Members already buy these products elsewhere; your job is part of helping them buy through us instead. VAs who are sharp, consistent, and good at building relationships in the community can grow this into serious income over time. We’re looking for people who want to grow with us, not just clock hours.



## What You’ll Be Doing



- Creating 2 graphic posts per day for the Skool community (educational content — peptide info, tips, brand-consistent visuals)

- Posting 3 polls per day designed to spark engagement and conversation

- Messaging at least 3 members per day to build relationships, answer questions, and guide them toward our products

- Responding to member questions and comments across the community

- Communicating regularly with me on priorities, content direction, and member feedback

- Helping keep the community active, engaged, and informed

- Reliable and consistent — daily tasks need to happen daily, not in batches

- Bonus: experience with Skool, health/fitness content, or wellness/supplement spaces



## Pay Structure



- **Base pay:** $2.50/hour, paid weekly

- **Commission:** $5 per product sold that you can be credited with generating (through your outreach, content, or conversations)

- Your income is built primarily through commission — the base pay covers your time on daily tasks, but your earning potential is tied to how well you drive engagement and sales

- Top performers will have opportunities for increased base pay, more responsibility, and higher commission tiers as the community and brand grow



## Growth Path



This is a **starter position** — it’s the entry point into the brand, not the ceiling. As the community and sales grow, I’ll be promoting one person into a **Manager role** overseeing bigger responsibilities: website management, social media sales strategy, and leading other VAs/tea
mbers.



VAs who are consistent, sharp, and good at driving engagement and sales have real potential to earn over $1,000/month as commission scales — this isn’t capped, and it isn’t guaranteed; it’s tied directly to your performance and the community’s growth. The harder and smarter you work this, the more you make and the faster you move up.

Reply to this job post with:

title: Paid Ads Manager | Meta and Google | Ecommerce and Short Term Rentals
description:
**Paid Ads Manager | Meta and Google | Ecommerce and Short Term Rentals**



---



We run two businesses. An ecommerce store that sells physical products and a short term rental property business. We need one sharp person who can run paid ads across both. Not someone who has only boosted posts or followed a template. Someone who actually understands how paid traffic works, how funnels work, and how to turn ad spend into real revenue.



Meta is the priority. If you are not strong on Meta do not apply.



---



**What you will be doing**



On the ecommerce side you will be running Meta ads to test and scale winning products. That means building campaigns from scratch, writing ad copy, selecting or editing video creatives, testing angles, monitoring performance daily, cutting what is losing, and scaling what is converting. You will also support Google Shopping campaigns for our Shopify store and make sure our product ads are structured correctly and performing.



On the short term rental side you will be running Meta and Google ads to generate direct bookings for our properties. That means building awareness and retargeting campaigns, driving traffic to landing pages, and optimizing for bookings and inquiries. You will need to understand how to speak to a traveler audience and what makes someone click and book.



Across both businesses you will be responsible for campaign setup, creative testing, budget management, performance reporting, and ongoing optimization. You will also support landing page setup or improvements when needed to make sure the traffic we are paying for actually converts.



---



**What we need from you**



You have run Meta ads for an ecommerce brand before and you can show us results. You understand campaign structure, ad sets, audiences, creative testing, and how to read the numbers. You know what a winning creative looks like and you know how to find or build one. You understand direct response marketing. You are not just running brand awareness. You are running ads that are supposed to make people take action right now. You know how Google Shopping works and you have set up or managed Performance Max or standard Shopping campaigns before. You understand funnels. You know that the ad is only one part of the equation and that the landing page, the offer, and the follow up all matter. You are comfortable setting up or improving landing pages to support your campaigns. You are organized and you report clearly. We need to know what is working, what is not, and what you are doing about it.



---



**Experience that will move you to the top of the list**



You have managed a monthly ad budget of at least five thousand dollars across Meta or Google. You have run ads for both ecommerce and service based businesses before. You have experience with short term rentals, hospitality, travel, or local service businesses. You have used tools like Triple Whale, Northbeam, or any attribution platform. You have built or optimized landing pages using tools like GoHighLevel, ClickFunnels, Unbounce, or similar. You understand creative strategy and can give direction to a video editor or content creator to produce better ad creatives.



---



**Tools you should know**



Meta Business Manager for campaign setup and management. Google Ads for Shopping, Search, and Performance Max campaigns. Google Analytics for traffic and conversion tracking. Any landing page builder — GoHighLevel, ClickFunnels, Unbounce, Shopify pages, or similar. Canva or any basic design tool for simple creative edits. Claude, ChatGPT or any AI tool for copy and research. Spreadsheets for reporting and budget tracking.



---



**How we work**



This is a full time role. You will manage ad accounts across both businesses and report directly to the owner. We expect clear communication, proactive updates, and a mindset focused on results not just activity. We do not want someone who runs ads and waits to be told what to fix. We want someone who sees a problem and fixes it before we even notice it.



---



**How to apply**



Show us real results. Tell us about a Meta campaign you ran for an ecommerce brand. What was the product, what was the ad spend, what was the return, and what did you do to get there. Tell us about any experience running ads for service businesses, hospitality, or bookings. Share any landing pages you have built or improved. Tell us your monthly ad spend experience. Tell us which tools you use and why.



If your application does not include real numbers and real examples we will not respond. If it does we will get back to you fast.

title: Ecommerce Growth Operator | Supplement Brand | TikTok Research and Meta Ads
description:
**Ecommerce Growth Operator | Supplement Brand | TikTok Research and Meta Ads**



---



We are building a supplement brand from the ground up. The model is simple. We find supplement products that are already proven on TikTok Shop, private label our own version, build a Shopify store around it, and scale it with Meta ads. We move fast, we test fast, and we double down on what works.



We are not looking for someone to manage tasks. We are looking for someone who understands this model, has done something like it before, and can take a product from research to live store to running ads without needing their hand held every step of the way.



---



**What this role actually looks like**



You will spend time researching supplement products that are already selling well on TikTok Shop. You are looking for products with strong demand signals, real social proof, good margins, and room to compete with a private label version. Once you identify a winner you will help us source a private label version, work with our supplier to get it produced or fulfilled, and build a Shopify store around it that is clean, trustworthy, and built to convert.



Then you launch Meta ads. You find the best performing videos for that product or category, make them better, write the copy, set up the campaigns, and monitor performance daily. You cut what is not working and push harder on what is converting. You understand that in the supplement space trust and credibility are everything so the store, the ads, and the messaging all need to feel legitimate and professional.



You will also handle supplier communication, verify orders, coordinate fulfillment, and keep operations organized as we scale.



---



**The supplement space has specific requirements and you need to understand them**



Supplement ads on Meta have strict rules. You cannot make certain health claims. You cannot use before and after imagery in certain ways. You need to know what gets ads disapproved and how to write copy that converts without triggering a policy violation. If you have never run supplement ads before this is not the role for you. If you have and you know how to navigate the compliance side while still writing ads that sell this is exactly the role for you.



The same applies to the store. A supplement store needs to feel credible. That means professional product photography or AI generated imagery that looks real, clear ingredient information, trust signals like reviews and guarantees, and copy that speaks to real customer concerns without making illegal claims.



---



**Who we are looking for**



You have researched winning products on TikTok Shop before and you can walk us through your process. You have run Meta ads for a physical product brand and you have real numbers to show for it. You understand the supplement space well enough to know what sells, what claims are allowed, and how to position a private label product against established brands. You can build a Shopify store from scratch in under 8 hours. You are comfortable sourcing private label products and communicating with suppliers. You use AI tools every day to speed up research, copy, and creative production. You work independently and you are focused on results not just completing tasks.



---



**You are not the right fit if**



You have never run a paid ad campaign from scratch. You do not understand supplement compliance on Meta. You need a team around you to do product research. You cannot show us proof of something you tested and what happened. You are looking for a slow paced admin role.



---



**Experience that will move you to the top of the list**



You have run Meta ads specifically for a supplement or health and wellness brand. You have private labeled a product before and understand the sourcing and fulfillment process. You have used Kalodata or a similar tool for TikTok product research. You have experience with supplement compliance on Meta and know how to write copy that converts without violating policies. You have built a Shopify store for a health or wellness brand that felt credible and professional.



---



**Tools you should know**



Kalodata for TikTok product research and validation. Shopify for store builds and product management. Meta Business Manager for campaign setup and management. CapCut or any video editor for creative production. Claude, ChatGPT or any AI tool for copy, research, and workflow. Triple Whale or any attribution and tracking tool is a strong plus. Canva or Photoshop for basic image editing and visual work.



---



**How we structure pay**



Base hourly rate plus a performance percentage tied to sales you directly generate. If you find winners and scale them your earnings grow with the results. We start with a short trial period so both sides can see if this works before committing long term.



---



**How to apply**



We want proof not promises. Tell us about a product you researched and tested. What was it, how did you find it, and what happened with the numbers. Tell us about any supplement or health brand experience you have. Share any Meta ad results you have even rough numbers are fine. Tell us your product research process step by step. Tell us which tools you use and why. If you have private labeled a product before tell us about that specifically.



Generic applications will not be considered. Specific ones with real examples and real numbers will get a fast response.

description:
ADVICE ASSOCIATE - FINANCIAL ADVICE INDUSTRY (APPLY IF WITH EXPERIENCE)

Location: Remote

Type: Full-time

Salary: AUD$10-$15ph



ABOUT LIFE UNSHACKLED

LifeUnshackled is a platform built to help people reclaim the life they once dreamed of, clients and team alike. We exist because “retire comfortably” is not the goal, freedom is. We bring bold financial strategy and strong follow-through so clients can build real wealth and live life on their terms. You will be joining a growth-minded team that cares about ambition, high standards, and doing work that genuinely helps people unshackle their lives.



ABOUT THE ROLE

The Associate is the operational and relational lead for their assigned clients, acting as the Chief Operating Officer of each client relationship. This role combines precision in data and document management, project management discipline, people and communication skills, hands-on platform execution, and a delegation mindset. Each Associate is responsible for ensuring timely, compliant, and high-quality delivery of financial advice implementation and client outcomes, in coordination with the broader LifeUnshackled team.



FOUR KEY AREAS OF RESPONSIBILITIES

1. The Information Steward

- Custodian of all essential client information and access rights.

- Curate and maintain a “Client Support Pack” with critical data and supporting documents for rapid use in preparing application forms. This includes identity documents (individuals and entities), FATCA, ABNs, ACNs, TFNs, ESAs, bank accounts, wholesale certificates, etc.

- Collect and store tax-related and performance-related documentation (e.g. holding, distribution, loan, rental, annual, market value, tax statements).

- Maintain and enforce the standard client folder structure, file naming conventions, and financial year categorisation so that files are audit-ready at all times.

- Own the client Fact Find end-to-end — keeping it current after every meeting, statement, or client communication, and ensuring it underpins all advice documents as an auditable chain of evidence.

- Monitor and update the real-time client balance sheet, sourcing data from various platforms and reconciling across systems quarterly.

- Ensure adviser access and login credentials are in place and securely managed across all relevant platforms.

- Collaborate with the PSM to standardise and streamline information management.

- Mindset: “Would I be confident this is clean and client-ready at any time?”



2. The Delivery Project Manager

- Leader of accurate client service implementation and delivery timelines.

- Ensure investment transactions are implemented same-day and insurance applications are begun within 48 hours of approval.

- Turn meeting actions and strategic goals into clearly written, trackable tasks — nothing falls through the cracks.

- Own timelines and deadlines — chasing overdue tasks, flagging bottlenecks, and ensuring every task reaches a clear resolution.

- Delegate technical or administrative tasks appropriately while owning the outcome.

- Coordinate closely with paraplanners, the Practice Support Manager, the Principal Adviser, and external professionals.

- Ensure documents and forms are completed correctly, on time, and sent to the right parties.

- Mindset: “What’s needed to move this forward without needing Principal involvement?”



3. The Relationship Anchor

- Point of continuity, context, and connection for each client.

- Understand the needs and preferences of your clients and orchestrate effective service delivery accordingly.

- Be the primary internal advocate and coordinator for your clients.

- Track developments in the client’s personal and financial life.

- Stay across all meeting notes and ensure task systems reflect meetings.

- Notice changes in goals, mindset, or relationships and raise them with the Principal.

- Support the Principal by ensuring they are well-informed before every meeting.

- Ensure the client never has to repeat themselves or chase us for updates.

- Mindset: “What’s shifted for the client that we haven’t yet actioned?”



4. The Compliant Storyteller

- Ensuring each client file tells a compelling and compliant story.

- Keep client files audit-ready with consistent, clear, and updated notes.

- Manage the full post-meeting workflow: consent and transcription, file note generation and review, follow-up
s, and updating the Fact Find with any new information.

- Ensure fact finds, SOAs, ROAs, and client communications are accurate and well-organised.

- Maintain clarity in the chronology and context of advice decisions.

- Highlight progress and transformation in the client’s journey, tying actions back to their goals.

- Ensure documentation not only meets compliance and privacy standards but tells the narrative of value delivered.

- Mindset: “Would this file make sense to an outsider, showing a clear and compliant story of impact?”



PRIORITISATION ORDER

- From a business perspective, your tasks should be prioritised in the following order:

- Cash / investment transacting, including opening of associated accounts and completion of any KYC / onboarding requirements with third parties where this would delay a cash / investment transaction.

- Insurance applications and getting policies into force.

- Preparing meeting summaries and post-meeting
s for your clients, and any sub-10-minute tasks that are directly requested of you by the Principal Adviser.

- Responding to requests made of us by other professionals (we expect fast responses from them and should return the favour).

- Other work pertaining to clients who are in their first 6 weeks with us (including onboarding).

- Other work pertaining to your broader client list, prioritised by the annual fee that they are paying us and any relationship considerations (including preparing their reports / maintaining their client file with current information / supporting loan applications / etc).

- Balance this priority list with approaching deadlines — as deadlines near, the work becomes a higher priority.

- Anything you can’t get to in a reasonable time, just flag it, and we can try to delegate to others or make a business decision to defer that task.



REPORTING & COLLABORATION

Reports to: Practice Support Manager (PSM) for delivery oversight; Principal Adviser for client outcomes.

Collaborates with: PSM, Paraplanner, Admin Assistant, Principal Adviser.



Indicators of Success

- 100% of clients have complete, current documentation and adviser access.

- Tasks are delivered on time with minimal Principal intervention.

- High service ratings and positive feedback from assigned clients.

- Accurate and timely handoff of technical and administrative work.

- Adviser’s administrative workload is reduced for each client in your portfolio.

- Investment transactions executed same-day; insurance applications commenced within 48 hours.

- Demonstrated proficiency across all required platforms.



Expected Behaviour

- Proactive, reliable, and accountable.

- Thoughtful and detail-oriented.

- Able to prioritise and escalate as needed.

- Collaborative, not siloed.

- Focused on both client satisfaction and internal efficiency.

Quality Assurance, Accountability & Compliance

• Conduct quality checks on sales calls, calendar availability, CRM hygiene, and follow-up sequences.

• Audit all sales data regularly (bookings, show rates, sales, payments, renewals) to ensure accuracy before reporting.

• Flag performance gaps early and coach tea
mbers with clarity, empathy, and firmness.

Cross-Department Coordination

Reporting & Performance Management

title: Purple – Full-Time AI UGC TikTok Shop Affiliate Operator
description:
Title:

Purple – Full-Time AI UGC TikTok Shop Affiliate Operator



Job Description:



We are looking for a serious, full-time AI UGC TikTok Shop Affiliate Operator to help us turn an existing TikTok account with almost 300,000 followers into a revenue-generating TikTok Shop affiliate and product promotion channel.



This is not a basic video editing role.



This is not for a generic VA.



This is not for someone who is just “interested in AI.”



We need someone who can create realistic AI UGC product videos that feel natural, native to TikTok, and not obviously AI-generated.



The right person should be able to help create videos where an AI model/person naturally talks about, holds, uses, demonstrates, reviews, or recommends a product.



We are looking for someone who can move fast, produce daily content, follow a system, communicate clearly, and help us build a serious TikTok Shop affiliate content machine.



Main Responsibilities



You will help with:



Creating realistic AI UGC-style product videos

Using model reference images to keep the same AI person consistent across multiple videos

Creating videos where the AI model naturally holds, uses, applies, demonstrates, or talks about products

Creating strong TikTok hooks, product angles, and CTAs

Using AI tools to generate images, video clips, voiceovers, and realistic product scenes

Editing final videos in CapCut for TikTok-style pacing, captions, retention, and conversion

Producing multiple short-form videos per day

Organizing final videos in Google Drive or shared folders

Helping maintain a content/posting calendar

Uploading or preparing videos for TikTok

Managing or coordinating TikTok Shop product links

Tracking video performance, clicks, sales, commissions, and revenue

Identifying winning products, hooks, and content angles

Helping us d
 what content to create more of based on performance

Potentially helping reach out to brands, sellers, or product partners for collaboration, product seeding, or affiliate opportunities

Tools We Care About



You do not need to know every tool, but you must already be experienced with AI video/content creation and able to learn new tools quickly.



Relevant tools include:



Veo

Sora

Kling

HeyGen

Higgsfield

Nano Banana Pro

ElevenLabs

CapCut

ChatGPT

Claude

Grok

Flux

Seedance

Seedream

TikTok Shop

TikTok Creative Center

Google Sheets

Google Drive



Experience with CapCut, ElevenLabs, and at least 2 to 3 advanced AI video/image tools is strongly preferred.



Product Categories



We are especially interested in TikTok-friendly ecommerce categories such as:



Beauty

Skincare

Wellness

Personal care

Supplements

Lifestyle products

Home products

Gadgets

Fitness products

Fashion accessories



Experience creating content for beauty, skincare, wellness, personal care, supplements, or ecommerce products is a major plus.



You Are a Strong Fit If



You are a strong fit if:



You have created realistic AI UGC product videos before

You understand TikTok hooks, pacing, retention, and native-style content

You can make AI videos look natural and not fake

You can create consistent AI characters/models

You can work with product references and model references

You understand ecommerce product marketing

You can produce content daily

You can follow instructions and improve based on feedback

You are organized and can track work clearly

You are comfortable using Google Sheets for tracking/reporting

You are willing to learn TikTok Shop affiliate operations if you do not already know them

You want a long-term full-time role

Do Not Apply If



Please do not apply if:



You are only a basic video editor

You are only a Canva designer

You are a generic VA with no AI UGC experience

You have never created realistic AI product videos

Your AI videos look fake, stiff, robotic, or obviously generated

You cannot create daily content

You need constant hand-holding

You cannot communicate clearly

You are not comfortable tracking performance or reporting results

You are not willing to learn TikTok Shop affiliate operations

You rely on AI tools but lack creative judgment

TikTok Shop Experience



TikTok Shop experience is strongly preferred, but not required.



If you do not have direct TikTok Shop management experience, that is okay as long as you are highly organized, analytical, coachable, and willing to learn quickly.



Over time, this role may include helping with:



Product links

Affiliate content workflow

Posting strategy

Performance tracking

Commission/revenue reporting

Brand or seller outreach
