Character/model consistency

Product demonstration quality

Voiceover and lip sync

TikTok-style editing

Speed of delivery

Communication

Ability to follow instructions

Organization and reporting



If the trial goes well, this can become a stable long-term full-time role.



How to Apply



To apply, include the word Purple in your application heading so we know you read the full post.



Please answer these questions directly:

title: COO/Management Residential Appraisal Report Writer
description:
We are a successful residential appraisal firm located in the Bay Area, California. We employ over 10 on the team and are looking for a very senior level experienced residential appraisal report writer to lead our team.



The team includes 3 Bay Area appraisers and 8 employees in the Philippines. We are rapidly growing and are looking for someone with experience completing the entire residential appraisal report, including commentary, who ideally has experience with managing and leading other appraisal report writers. Your role will effectively be acting as chief operating officer of our company while also being directly involved in reports.



Your role and responsibilities include the following:

1. Ensuring every report is completed to our standards. Either directly or through the processes and procedures you develop, it will be your responsibility to ensure that each and every report created by our report writers is free from errors and submission-ready. While this will start by having you directly review each report written by our team before submission, we are in the process of also hiring quality assurance reviewers, who you will lead and manage.

2. Training and managing residential report writers. It will be your responsibility to ensure that all report writers on our tea
et the criteria and standards in place to ensure high quality reports.

3. Acting as the liaison between leadership and the report writing staff. If there is too much work for the team, you will be in charge of letting leadership know so that additional tea
mbers can be hired. Or if there are any other issues, you will be in charge of resolving them or bringing it to leadership's attention.

4. Acting as the closer. Ultimately, everything on the report writing side will fall under your responsibility. We are looking for someone who is proactive at solving problems without getting the leadership team involved, however we are of course readily available to help out when needed. In line with this, if the report writing team doesn't have capacity to complete a residential report, you are expected to directly help out and complete these reports while at the same time working towards a solution to address this issue (hiring more, building better processes for writing reports, involving AI, etc).



To be considered for this role, you must meet the following criteria:

1. You have extensive work history writing reports for a US residential appraiser. Ideally you have done this for California properties. You must have extensive experience completing the entire report, everything from data entry to sketch to adjustments, 1004MC, selecting comparables, and commentary. If you do not have this experience, we will be unable to consider you for this position.

2. Ideally you have existing management experience, managing other appraisal report writers.



We are flexible with your work hours and offer Philippine daytime shift hours for your convenience. We would like to start part time but then transition to full time, so ideally you are open to working full time exclusively with us if its a mutual fit.



To be considered for this position, you must do the following in your application message (failure to do all of the following will result in your application being ignored):

1. How many years have you worked for a US residential appraiser? What tasks did you perform for them?

2. How many hours does it take you to complete one report? What parts of the report do you complete?

3. Do you have experience writing commentary for the addendum, drawing the sketch, labeling photos, and creating the 1004MC? Please indicate which ones you have experience with, and how many years for each.

4. Please provide a sample of at least one appraisal report you have fully completed. You can redact any private information from the report. Please let me know what parts exactly you completed on this report(s).

5. Provide a publicly accessible link to your resume.

6. Are you open to starting part time and then transitioning to full time? Once working full time with us, will you be working exclusively with us without any other jobs? When is the earliest you can begin working with us?

7. What are your preferred working hours?

8. Do you have experience managing other residential appraisal report writers? If so, please discuss in detail your job responsibilities.

9. Do you have experience in reviewing other residential reports? If so, please discuss in detail your responsibilities.



Thank you, and I look forward to the opportunity to work together.

title: TikTok Product Research, Build Shopify Store  and Run Meta Ads Operator | Ecommerce Growth Role**
description:
**TikTok Product Research and Meta Ads Operator | Ecommerce Growth Role**



---



We run a lean ecommerce operation. The model is simple. We find products that are already proven on TikTok Shop, build a Shopify store around them, run Meta ads to scale what converts, and cut everything that does not. We move fast and we reward people who can move fast with us.



We are not looking for someone to manage tasks. We are looking for someone who can find a winning product, build a store around it, launch ads, and tell us what the numbers are saying. If that sounds like what you already do, keep reading.



---



**What you will actually be doing**



Finding products that are already selling well on TikTok Shop using tools like Kalodata. You are not guessing. You are looking at real data. Volume, engagement, competition, margins. Once you find something worth testing you build a Shopify store around it. Fast. We are talking under 8 hours from zero to live. Then you find the best performing videos for that product, make them better, and use them to run Meta ads. You watch the numbers, cut what is losing, and push harder on what is winning. You handle supplier communication, verify orders, and keep everything organized as we scale.



---



**The kind of person we are looking for**



You have found a winning product before and you can tell us the story. You have run Meta ads from scratch including the Business Manager setup, pixel, ad copy, and creative. You know what a 25x ROAS looks like and you know what killed the campaigns that did not work. You can build a Shopify store from scratch including domain, product page, policies, and shipping in one sitting. You are comfortable editing or repurposing TikTok videos into ad creatives. You use AI tools every single day without being asked. You work independently. You do not need someone checking in on you every hour to stay on track.



---



**You are not the right fit if**



You have never actually launched a paid ad campaign from scratch. You need a team around you to do product research. You are looking for a slow paced admin role. You cannot show us proof of something you tested and what happened.



---



**Tools you should know**



Kalodata for product research. Shopify for store builds. Meta Business Manager for ads. CapCut or any video editor for creatives. ChatGPT or any AI tool for copy, research, and workflow. Triple Whale or any pixel and conversion tracking tool is a strong plus.



---



**How we structure pay**



Base hourly rate plus a percentage of sales you directly generate. If you find winners and scale them your earnings grow with the results. We start with a two week trial so both sides can see if this is a good fit before committing long term.



---



**How to apply**



We want to see proof not promises. Tell us about a product you found, tested, and what happened. Show us a store you built. Share ad results even if they are rough numbers. Tell us your product research process step by step. Tell us which tools you use and why.



If your application is generic we will not respond. If it is specific and shows real experience we will get back to you fast.

title: E-commerce Finance & Accounting Specialist
description:
## Summary



We are looking for a reliable and proactive finance employee to manage the day-to-day financial operations of our e-commerce businesses.



The role includes tracking invoices and payments, managing our accounts-payable Gmail inbox, maintaining QuickBooks, reconciling Wise, PayPal, banks and payment processors, tracking inventory, preparing financial reports, and potentially helping with cash-flow forecasting.



This is not a role for someone who only follows SOPs. We need someone who takes ownership, notices problems, investigates discrepancies, and reports unexpected issues promptly.



## Responsibilities



* Manage the accounts-payable Gmail inbox

* Track vendor and contractor invoices

* Organize invoices using Gmail labels

* Record invoice amounts, currencies, due dates and payment status

* Check for duplicate, incorrect or suspicious invoices

* Prepare payments through Wise, PayPal and bank accounts

* Track scheduled, completed, failed and overdue payments

* Maintain accurate records in QuickBooks

* Reconcile banks, credit cards, Wise, PayPal, Shopify and payment processors

* Track Shopify sales, refunds, chargebacks, fees and payouts

* Track payment-processor reserves, holds and delayed payouts

* Track inventory levels and stock movements

* Reconcile inventory records with Shopify, suppliers and warehouses

* Track purchase orders, supplier deposits and incoming inventory

* Maintain inventory valuation, COGS and landed-cost records

* Track advertising, shipping, fulfilment, software and processing expenses

* Prepare weekly and monthly financial reports

* Report unpaid invoices, upcoming payments and cash requirements

* Assist with cash-flow forecasting, budgeting and financial planning

* Keep financial documents organized for accountants and tax filings



## Reporting



You must promptly report unexpected issues such as:



* Missing or duplicate invoices

* Unusual charges

* Changes to vendor payment details

* Failed or delayed payments

* Missing payouts

* Reconciliation discrepancies

* Processor reserves or account holds

* Inventory shortages

* Unexpected increases in costs

* Suspicious transactions



Your report should explain what happened, the financial impact, what you investigated, and your recommended next step.



## Requirements



* Previous finance, bookkeeping or accounting experience

* E-commerce or DTC experience

* Strong QuickBooks knowledge

* Experience with Wise, PayPal, Shopify and online banking

* Strong spreadsheet skills

* Understanding of inventory, COGS and reconciliations

* Strong attention to detail

* High initiative and independent problem-solving ability

* Clear written English

* Reliable communication and follow-through

* Ability to handle sensitive financial information responsibly



## Security



You may prepare payments, but final payment approval will remain with management.



Any changes to vendor banking information must be independently verified before payment.



## To Apply



Please include:



1. A summary of your e-commerce finance or bookkeeping experience

2. The software and payment platforms you have used

3. Your experience with QuickBooks, inventory and reconciliations

4. An example of a financial discrepancy you identified and resolved

5. Your availability and expected hourly rate

6. Your MBTI type

title: Growth Marketer
description:
What you build matters more than what you call yourself.



A short pitch for who this is:



You're the person already spending time in WordPress threads, dev subreddits, and indie-hacker corners. Not because it's a job. Because you find it interesting. You answer questions because answering questions is how you think.



You don't run marketing through scheduling tools and call it a strategy. You read replies. You notice tone. You know which mod will nuke a link and which one will let it through if the comment actually helps.



You've sent cold
s that got real responses, and you can explain why those ones worked.



ABOUT SGEN



SGEN's product is solid. The voice is dialed. Docs are clean.



What's missing: a person who's in the room when WordPress users are venting, comparing options, asking the question that SGEN can answer.



When somebody posts at 1 AM about a plugin conflict that just nuked a client site, there's no SGEN reply in that thread.



When an agency owner asks Hacker News for a serious WordPress alternative, no one from our side shows up.



When a sandbox user signs up and goes quiet for two weeks, nothing reaches out.



That's the work. Daily presence — in communities, inboxes, and the funnel — done by someone who treats it as a craft, not a queue.



WHO FITS



You're patient with people and impatient with bad writing.



You'd rather post one thoughtful reply than five generic ones.



You think "automate the outreach" usually translates to "stop caring about the person on the other end."



You can read a thread and feel where the conversation is heading before it gets there.



You know community work runs on consistency, not bursts. You're prepared to be in the same places for months before they trust you.



HAVE A REAL TAKE ON WORDPRESS



Doesn't matter which way. Pro, anti, complicated — all fine.



What matters: you've used it enough to talk about it without faking. You can describe what people love about it and where it breaks down. When you bring SGEN into a conversation, it's because the conversation called for it — not because you had a quota.



People in those communities can tell the difference between somebody who knows the ecosystem and somebody running a script.



STEADY WHEN THINGS GET NOISY



Reddit will push back. Hacker News will be skeptical. Somebody will accuse SGEN of being vaporware, or worse.



You don't fight it. You don't flood the thread with a defense.



You answer once, calmly, with substance. Then you let the comment do its work.



You've been around online long enough to know when a remark deserves a reply and when it deserves to drift.



THE ACTUAL WORK



Communities. Reddit (WP-adjacent and agency-adjacent subs), Hacker News, IndieHackers, dev-focused 
s and Slack groups. Show up where the audience already is. Reply with substance. Build a profile that earns its own credibility — not just SGEN's.



Inbox.
 sequences for sandbox users, drip flows for trial accounts that stalled, founder-style outreach to agencies worth a direct ask. Cadence and segmentation are your call. Voice support is there when you want it.



Funnel. Watch the signup path, find where it breaks, write the experiment, ship it, report back without the gloss. Tag every signup with first-touch source so the team knows what's actually working.



Monthly read-out. Plain English. What moved, what didn't, what you're trying next. No vanity slide decks.



WHAT WE’RE CHECKING FOR



- English that reads native. US/UK readers shouldn't catch a translation feel. SGEN talks to a Western technical audience.

Real community track record. Two-plus years of being a regular somewhere — posting, replying, helping. We'll look at your account.



-
 that converted. Sequences you wrote, what you learned, what you'd change. Open and reply rates if you have them.



- Working knowledge of WordPress. You don't need to be a developer. You need to be able to talk to its users without sounding like an outsider.



- A preference for showing up over automating. Tools help eventually. Presence wins first.



- Self-editing. You re-read before you post. You delete the line that sounds salesy. You don't ship the first draft.



PROBABLY IF YOU…



- You have a Reddit account with karma in places that aren't easy to game.

- You've written a cold
 that got a real reply and you can explain why.

- You can spot an AI-written marketing
 from the first sentence.

- "Growth hacking" is a phrase you mostly roll your eyes at.

- You've spent unpaid hours helping people online because the question was interesting.

- You know which subs tolerate a link and which will incinerate it.



WHAT THIS ISN’T



It isn't running a content mill.



It isn't standing up an automation stack and calling that strategy.



It isn't copy-pasting the same post across five channels.



It isn't outsourcing presence to scheduling tools.



It's a person doing the work, in public, every week.



WHY IT MATTERS



Communities d
 trust slowly, then permanently.



If SGEN shows up in the right threads with real answers, over months, that trust compounds into word-of-mouth no ad campaign can buy.



If SGEN doesn't show up at all, every later marketing dollar will be working uphill against absence.



The right hire here makes SGEN feel present. The wrong hire here doesn't.



COMPENSATION

$600-$650 USD per month



SCHEDULE

- 8 hour shift, Monday to Friday, 7:00AM to 4:00PM Philippine Time.

- Minimal overtime during weekdays and weekends will be expected as part of salary



SGEN is proud to be an equal opportunity employer committed to a diverse and inclusive work environment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, marital status, disability, veteran status or any other basis protected by law.

title: Senior AI Systems Architect
description:
We are seeking a Senior AI Systems Architect to design, build, and scale a self-optimizing multi-agent framework. You will lead the development of a deterministic, autonomous infrastructure that moves beyond standard routing. This role focuses on combining state machine orchestration, reasoning distillation, and continuous architectural evolution to create a highly secure, self-improving AI ecosystem.



Responsibilities:



Core Architecture: Design and deploy highly deterministic, directed-graph orchestration layers to manage data flow and execution state across distributed AI nodes.



Self-Improving Loops: Integrate evolutionary algorithms and learn-experiment-analyze cycles, allowing the system to autonomously optimize its own routing and node logic.



Reasoning Distillation: Build mechanisms that capture probabilistic LLM reasoning trails and convert them into static, repeatable skillsets to reduce latency and hallucination.



Systems Governance: Develop an overarching control plane to enforce cross-agent policies, secure OS-level sandboxing, and strict API execution limits.



Prerequisites & Technical Requirements:



Advanced Orchestration: 5+ years of experience building complex state machines, DAG-based execution engines, and multi-agent workflows (e.g., LangGraph or similar).



AI-for-AI Experience: Deep understanding of automated research loops and evolutionary AI systems that can hypothesize, test, and analyze their own logic.



Execution Environments: Proven track record of managing secure agent deployments using meta-harnessing principles, declarative policies, and isolated cloud environments.



Systems Engineering: Strong proficiency in Python/TypeScript, asynchronous stream processing, and state checkpointing (e.g., PostgreSQL).



Security & Telemetry: Experience implementing robust AI security layers, intent-based controls, and unified telemetry for enterprise-scale deployments.

title: Freelance Video Editor (Premiere Pro), trial project with possible ongoing work
description:
Speck of Dust is a video production company in Sydney, Australia, working across documentary, sport and live-event content.



PLEASE READ THIS IN FULL BEFORE APPLYING. We receive a lot of generic, copy-paste applications, and we only consider people who are a genuine fit. Apply only if you are a genuine video editor with a real video editing reel. This is NOT a role for generalists, web or graphic designers, AI-content creators, or social-media content editors. If that is your background, please do not apply.



We are looking for a remote video editor, and we like to start with a single paid trial project so we can both see if it is a good fit. This first project is small (budget around US$150 to US$300). Only if it goes well would we then talk about more project work and, in time, a possible ongoing monthly arrangement. There is no immediate or permanent commitment up front, and nothing is locked in.



THE WORK (the trial project). It is a fun, upbeat highlight edit of an event night: the kind of piece that gives the people who took part a great memory to watch back and share. It is a single-camera job. You cut the best 
nts down into selects and assemble them into a finished piece of around 90 seconds (two minutes maximum). It opens with a short presenter introduction, moves through people arriving and enjoying the experience, carries a short interview section around the halfway mark, and builds to a high point before closing on a sponsor logo we supply.



The feel is celebratory and energetic, driven by well-known upbeat pop music, with the cuts and speed ramps timed to the rhythm. Golden 
nts are kept in their original slow motion. The footage is shot on a Canon C400 (C-Log2 profile) and you apply a LUT we provide before any grading. We give you reference edits to match for pacing, structure and feel, so you are not starting from a blank page. It is edited in Premiere Pro, you hand back the Premiere project file, and review happens in 
 with time-coded notes (one revision round on the trial).



Beyond this first project, our work overall ranges from emotionally driven, story-led documentary pieces through to fast, energetic sport and event edits.



WHAT THIS IS NOT. We are not looking for a generalist social-media editor. If your main experience is editing for YouTubers, Instagram, or short-form social (for example CapCut-style content), we are probably not the right fit. We don't do disposable, templated clips with tacky graphics, gimmicky sound effects, or AI-generated filler. We want a genuine video editor who specialises in considered, brief-led craft: emotional, story-led documentary work and cinematic, high-energy sport. Every piece is made to a specific brief, with real storytelling, craft and taste.



TWO THINGS WE WEIGH HEAVILY (these are core to the role, not nice-to-haves):

1. A strong, fluent command of English, written and spoken. We will assess this on a short video call.

2. A genuine video editor specialising in craft work, shown in a real editing reel, not generalist, social-media, web or graphic-design work.



YOU MUST HAVE (please be honest, this is where we have had trouble before):

- A computer that can genuinely handle large-format Canon C400 footage (.mxf, C-Log2) in Premiere Pro, with a proxy workflow if needed.

- Plenty of fast, free storage. Jobs are often 400GB or more.

- A fast, reliable internet connection. You will be downloading large media and that download time is real.

- Confidence with the 
 Transfer app and the Google Drive app, and with relinking media in Premiere.

- Premiere Pro, and you hand back the Premiere project file on delivery.

- Comfortable applying a supplied LUT, working with slow motion and speed ramps, and cutting to music.

- Organised and reliable, and comfortable communicating day to day on Google Chat or WhatsApp.

- Able to take feedback through 
 time-coded notes and action it properly.



A BONUS (not a dealbreaker): After Effects and a sophisticated hand with visual effects.



TO APPLY, please include:

1. Two or three of your most relevant samples as direct video links (for example Vimeo or an unlisted YouTube link), ideally matching our work: one story-led emotional edit and one high-energy sport edit. If you do not have directly relevant work, send your strongest pieces instead. Please do NOT send a full Google Drive folder with endless lists and subfolders for us to dig through; pick your best two or three and link them directly. It must be genuine video editing work.

2. Your computer specs and storage.

3. Your internet speed.

4. Your rate for a single project like this, and your monthly rate if we were ever to move to ongoing work.

5. References and proof of the work and credentials you mention.

6. One thing from this brief that stood out to you, in a sentence, so we know you have actually read it. We read every application and can tell a copy-paste from a real one. Applications that clearly ignore this brief, or whose work is not genuine video editing, will not be considered.

A short video call is the next step so we can have a chat.

title: Performance Video Editor for Winning Meta Ads
description:
We’re looking for a highly skilled Performance Video Editor to help us iterate on winning Meta video ads.



This is not a role focused on creating brand films or editing generic social content. Your main job is to take proven winning ad concepts and turn them into high-quality variations that improve engagement, retention, clarity, and freshness, without damaging what made the ad work in the first place.



You will work with existing winning creatives that we hand to you. We will usually provide the strategic direction, testing hypothesis, new hooks when relevant, and structured feedback. We are looking for someone who can execute at a high level, collaborate well, and bring strong performance-editing instincts to the table.



What you’ll do

- Create variations of existing winning Meta video ads

- Improve pacing, tighten edits, and shorten videos where needed

- Add VFX, sound effects, motion emphasis, and visual polish to key moments

- Add and refine subtitles, captions, text overlays, and on-screen hierarchy

- Integrate B-roll and additional voice-over when provided

- Clean up audio and improve overall sound quality

- Clean up cuts and make edits feel sharper and more intentional

- Deliver polished, finished 9:16 exports optimized for Meta paid social

- Revise quickly and accurately based on structured feedback

- Occasionally suggest smart edit improvements beyond the brief, with reasoning



What this role is focused on

This role is about iterating on winners, not reinventing them.



We want someone who understands how to:

- preserve the winning core of an ad

- create controlled variations tied to a specific testing hypothesis

- improve engagement in different ways through editing

- make key moments land harder without overediting

- balance direct-response performance with high production quality



What we’ll provide

- The winning concept to iterate on

- A clear brief and testing hypothesis for each variation

- New hooks when needed

- Ideas for moments to emphasize

- Additional VO, B-roll direction, or text direction when relevant

- Structured feedback for revisions

- Our Brand Book with brand direction



What we need from you

- Strong experience editing performance creative / direct-response ads

- Strong understanding of Meta paid social

- Excellent pacing and retention instincts

- Advanced editing skills beyond basic raw UGC cutting

- Strong subtitle and text-overlay design sense

- Strong VFX / SFX / motion enhancement instincts

- Clean audio editing and finishing ability

- Ability to follow a brief while also contributing thoughtful ideas

- Strong organization, file hygiene, and version control

- Ability to deliver finished work at a consistently high standard



Important constraints

- The first 3 seconds are generally off-limits in terms of changing the underlying footage

- Effects, polish, and editing improvements can be added, but the core opening footage usually stays

- These are hypothesis-driven variations, not random creative remixes

- Revisions are part of the process and should not be an issue

- Deliverables must be high quality, with Meta-optimized resolutions and exports



Ideal profile

You’re likely a strong fit if you:

- have edited for DTC brands or performance agencies

- understand retention, payoff, proof, pacing, and direct-response structure

- know how to make ads feel fresher without changing the core concept too much

- can collaborate with founders / marketers and improve execution quality

- understand that every edit should serve performance, not just aesthetics



Nice to have

- Experience with supplement, wellness, health, or consumer product brands

- Ability to work in Premiere Pro and After Effects

- Ability to source or create tasteful supporting motion / visual enhancement where needed

- Familiarity with version testing workflows



Working setup

- Freelance to start

- Potential for regular ongoing work / retainer if the fit is strong

- Work will be assigned on a concept-by-concept basis around winning ads we want to scale or refresh



To apply

Please send:

- a short introduction

- relevant examples of performance / direct-response ad edits

- examples where you created variations of an existing winning concept

- the software you use

- your typical turnaround times

- your rate structure

- whether you are open to a paid trial task



When applying, include the phrase: “controlled variation beats random editing” so we know you read the full brief.

title: JOB TITLE: Full-Stack Developer (TypeScript / React / Node / Supabase), Part-Time, $10/hr SALARY FIELD: $800/month (20 h
description:
READ THIS ENTIRE POST BEFORE APPLYING.



This post is direct on purpose. It saves your time and ours. Applications that ignore the instructions at the bottom will not be replied to. And to be upfront about the process: text answers don't get you hired here. A screen-share does. If you're not willing to show your real work, live, on camera, stop reading now.



ABOUT US

1 DASH (
) is a US payments and merchant services company with 20+ years in the industry, serving businesses nationwide. Our stance with our customers is simple: "Running a business is hard. Your payments shouldn't be." The software behind that promise is what you'd be building: a payment and invoicing SaaS, an agent dashboard, a mobile app, and internal analysis tools. Our values are simplicity and transparency, in the product and in how we work. That's also why this post is blunt. Small dev team, zero bureaucracy, and the features you ship get used by real businesses to move real money.



THE STACK (THIS IS WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY WORK IN)

• TypeScript everywhere, strict mode

• Frontend: React 18/19, Next.js 15/16, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Radix UI, TanStack Query, React Hook Form, Zod

• Backend: Node 20, Express APIs

• Database: Supabase (Postgres + Auth), Drizzle ORM and Prisma

• Mobile: React Native / Expo with NativeWind and Zustand (nice to have, not required)

• Integrations: payment processor APIs (Valor, Dejavoo), OpenAI, Resend, webhooks

• Testing: Vitest, Playwright, Supertest

• Infra: Vercel, Railway, GitHub Actions, pnpm / Turbo monorepo



You do not need every item on this list. You do need to be genuinely strong in TypeScript, React, Node/Express, and 

SQL/Postgres.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Build features end-to-end: database schema, API endpoint, UI

• Fix bugs without being babysat

• Write typed, Zod-validated code that passes lint, typecheck, and tests before you say "done"

• Work with payment APIs and webhooks. This is fintech, correctness matters more than speed.

• Use AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, etc.) daily. We expect this. We don't care that you use AI, every good dev does now. We care whether you understand what it produces, and we will verify that live.



WHO THIS IS FOR

• Mid to senior level: around 3-5+ years of real, shipped work

• You can take a loosely defined task and come back with a working, tested feature

• You communicate proactively. Blocked means you communicate the same day, not three days later.

• You use AI tools heavily however, you can read, verify, and fix everything they produce. If you cannot explain your own code line-by-line on a call, please do not apply. You will be asked to.



Please DO NOT APPLY IF

• You're an agency or you plan to subcontract the work

• You need step-by-step instructions for every task

• You cannot explain code you've submitted without an AI tool open

• You will not record a Loom video or join a live screen-share call



PAY AND SCHEDULE

• $10 per hour. This is the rate.

• Part-time, around 20 hours per week to start. Can grow into more (and full-time) if you're good.

• Flexible schedule, long-term role.



THE HIRING PROCESS (SO YOU KNOW WHAT YOU'RE SIGNING UP FOR)

1. Application (instructions below)

2. 15-minute live screen-share call. You'll open your own code from the project in your Loom, and I'll ask you to walk through specific files, explain decisions, and reason through a change on the spot. I'll also show you a small snippet from your codebase and ask what it does and what's wrong with it. No prep needed if the work is actually yours.

Note on the call: AI tools must be closed during it. Not because we're anti-AI (you'll use Claude Code daily here) but because the call tests the one thing AI can't do for you: understanding.



HOW TO APPLY. FOLLOW THIS EXACTLY

Read carefully, because the first instruction is not where you expect it. Somewhere in this paragraph is your first filter: the first line of your application must be the word SHIPIT followed by the name of the database from our stack list above. Applications missing either are deleted unread. If you pasted this post into an AI tool and skimmed its summary, you've probably already failed.

1. Attach your resume, or include a Google Drive link set to "anyone with the link can view". A locked link counts as no resume.

2. Record a Loom video, 3-5 minutes. This is the core of your application. Requirements:

o Introduce yourself briefly on camera (face visible at the start)

o Say today's date and the word from your application's first line out loud

o Walk through ONE project you built. Show the actual code in your editor or the live app. No slideshows, no reading from a script.

o Open the git history or git blame on at least one file and show your commits

o Explain one hard problem you solved AND one design decision you'd make differently today

o Videos showing tutorial projects, cloned repos, or code you can't git-blame to yourself are an instant rejection

3. Answer ALL of the questions below, numbered. Skipped questions = deleted application. Keep answers SHORT, 2-3 sentences each. We can tell the difference between concise-because-you-know and long-because-AI-padded.



QUESTIONS: EXPERIENCE (links over stories, everything you claim should be checkable)

1. Years of professional experience, and the biggest thing you've shipped that is live right now. A link is required: live URL, App Store listing, or public repo. "I can't link anything" needs a one-sentence explanation (NDA, internal tool, etc.) plus the closest verifiable substitute.

2. Rate yourself 1-10 on each (be honest, the live call and test task will verify): TypeScript, React/Next.js, Node/Express, Postgres/SQL, Supabase.

3. One feature you built end-to-end, database to API to UI. Link the live feature, repo, or PR/commit range, and tell me which parts you personally wrote.

4. Have you worked with payments, fintech, or third-party API webhooks? One concrete example with specifics (which processor/API, what you handled).

5. GitHub or portfolio link. If your GitHub is empty, link whatever you HAVE built instead.



QUESTIONS: AI WORKFLOW

6. Which AI coding tools do you use daily and for how long? Then in 2-3 sentences: your last real task with one, what it got wrong, and what you fixed manually. (This gets verified on the call, so be accurate, not impressive.)



QUESTIONS: AVAILABILITY

7. How many hours per week are you actually available, and in what timezone?

Generic copy-paste cover letters will be deleted. AI-polished applications might slip past me here, but they do not survive the screen-share, so you're only wasting your own time. Only shortlisted applicants will hear back from us. If you followed everything above, you are already ahead of 90% of applicants.

title: SEO & Authority Content Lead
description:
What ranks in two years matters more than what publishes this week.



A short pitch for who this is:



You play the long game. You've watched a single well-built piece quietly drive traffic for years. You've also watched companies torch their search presence by pumping out AI-generated noise because someone read a thread about content velocity.



You don't confuse output with strategy.



You can pull up a SERP and explain, page by page, what each ranking result is doing well and where the gap is. You think most "SEO advice" online is recycled and shallow, and you can argue why.



ABOUT SGEN



SGEN doesn't yet have authority in search.



Somebody Googling "WordPress alternative for agencies" in 2027 should land on a SGEN piece that's actually useful — not keyword bait.



Somebody Googling "why Elementor sites are slow" should find a piece that explains the cause honestly and only mentions SGEN where the mention earns it.



Somebody Googling "headless vs full-stack CMS" should find a comparison that reads like it was written by someone who's built both.



That's the work — building the search-and-authority layer that compounds over years, not months.



WHO FITS



You've done patient SEO before. The kind that takes 9–12 months to show its full effect and then stays for years.



You know the difference between a topic cluster and a content calendar.



You can talk through search intent, internal linking, and E-E-A-T without sounding like you got it off a
 thread.



You treat Ahrefs and Semrush as inputs, not gospel.



You can read three paragraphs of a piece and tell whether the writer actually knows the subject.



You'd rather publish ten strong pieces a year than fifty mediocre ones.



HAVE A REAL TAKE ON CONTENT STRATEGY



You probably have strong opinions about most B2B SaaS blogs. The 5-reasons posts. The 4,000-word ultimate guides that say almost nothing. The AI-generated round-ups that age in weeks.



You can articulate why most company blogs underperform: too much volume, too little point of view, no internal-link architecture, no respect for the reader's time.



You believe quality compounds and volume decays — and you can back it with examples from work you've done.



STEADY THROUGH SLOW MONTHS



Some pieces won't rank for months. Some will spike at six. Some will get quietly large a year after publishing.



You don't panic at month-one numbers. You don't pivot the strategy after one flop. You measure, wait, revise, re-link, and let the work do its job.



Search authority is a long conversation. You're comfortable in long conversations.



THE ACTUAL WORK



Topic strategy. Map the keyword and concept universe SGEN should own — WordPress alternatives, modern CMS, agency tooling, hosting-plus-builder-plus-CMS as one platform. Cluster it. Sequence it. Build a 12-month plan, not a 30-day calendar.



Long-form pieces. Write or commission the deep posts — pillar articles, honest comparisons, technical explainers, opinion-led essays. The ones that get cited, linked to, and quoted in newsletters. Voice support from Jerome; distribution support from the Growth Marketer.



Comparison pages. SGEN vs. WordPress. SGEN vs. Webflow. SGEN vs. Framer. SGEN vs. Squarespace. Real comparisons that acknowledge where SGEN isn't the right answer. That honesty is what makes the rest of the page credible.



Internal architecture. Design how the content links to itself. Keep the structure clean. Prevent the sprawl that wrecks most company blogs after year two.



Editorial bar. Set the quality standard for the blog and enforce it. Lighter, faster posts from the Growth Marketer are welcome on their own lane; the authority pieces all run through you.



Measurement. Organic traffic by cluster, rank position on target queries, organic backlinks, pieces that worked and didn't. Monthly read-out, honest, no vanity metrics.



WHAT WE’RE CHECKING FOR



- A portfolio with rankings. Pieces you wrote that ranked or drove traffic. If you can talk through why they worked, even better.



- English that reads native. Long pieces have to hold the reader. Every paragraph earns its place.



- WordPress and adjacent-CMS literacy. You don't need to be a developer. You need enough fluency in the ecosystem — plugins, builders, hosts, the actual pain — to write about it credibly. Webflow, Framer, Ghost, Shopify experience is a plus.



- SEO that isn't tricks. Topic clusters, intent, internal linking, durable on-page. You can also explain why most public SEO advice is shallow.



- A track record of compounding work. A small number of pieces still driving traffic years after publishing beats a large number that stopped working in three months.



- Sustainable cadence. One serious piece every two weeks, at this length, at this depth. Not faster. Not slower.



PROBABLY YOU IF



- You can name three SaaS blogs you respect and three you consider noise — with reasoning for each.

- You've personally written a piece still ranking a year later.

- You've watched a content program fail because somebody confused "publish more" with "build authority."

- You've rewritten an old post and watched its traffic multiply.

- You think most AI content is going to age poorly, and you can say why.

- You enjoy reading SERPs.



WHAT THIS ISN’T



It isn't a content mill.



It isn't four AI-assisted posts a week.



It isn't repackaging the docs as blog posts.



It isn't competitor comparisons where SGEN always wins.



It's a long-horizon search strategy run by somebody who's done it before and has the receipts.



WHY IT MATTERS



Search is the most durable acquisition channel a software company has access to.



Communities shift. Algorithms change. Ads get expensive.



A piece that ranks on a high-intent query, with real depth and an honest point of view, keeps working for years.



The right hire here plants the pieces that quietly carry SGEN's growth long after they shipped. The wrong hire here publishes volume that ranks for nothing.



COMPENSATION

$600-$650 USD per month



SCHEDULE

- 8 hour shift, Monday to Friday, 7:00AM to 4:00PM Philippine Time.

- Minimal overtime during weekdays and weekends will be expected as part of salary

title: Digital Marketing Campaign Manager (Australia)
description:
Full-time remote, from the Philippines. Melbourne business hours. Above-market pay. Long-term. Direct to the agency director.



A four-in-one role: set the strategy, run the campaigns, prove the results, lead the client conversation.



This is a senior, client-facing seat inside an established Australian digital agency — the person every campaign flows through. You'll work directly with the agency director, own a portfolio of Australian SME clients, and run integrated campaigns end-to-end across SEO, Google Ads, and paid + organic social. Real ownership, real variety, and a clear path to coordinator or senior as the agency grows.





Why this role



You'll work directly with the agency director. Your strategy, your campaigns, your client calls — no layer in between.



A real seat at an established agency. A growing Australian digital agency with a real client book — you'll own multiple Australian SME accounts across varied industries, not stuck on one.



Above-market pay, reliably on time. This is not a budget hire.



Long-term and stable. Full-time, ongoing, with a clear path to coordinator or senior as the agency grows.



Variety of clients and industries. Multiple parallel accounts, varied verticals, real briefs — you'll deepen your craft fast.



A small, high-trust team. Agency director, design team, build team, and you running the campaigns. No layers, no committees, no internal politics.





The brief



A growing Australian digital marketing agency is hiring a full-time Digital Marketing Campaign Manager to join the team remotely from the Philippines.



You plan the campaign, execute across paid and organic channels, report what worked and what didn't, and talk the client through it — calmly, in clear English, on camera. Campaigns span SEO, Google Ads, and social (paid and organic) across
, Instagram, and LinkedIn. You are the person the agency director hands a client to and trusts to deliver.



If you are a deep specialist in one channel who'd rather not be in front of a client — this role is not for you.





The team you'll work with



You'll sit alongside the agency director (who handles sales and overall direction), the agency's design team (creative and ad assets), the build team (web and tech), and a small group of specialist partners. A small, capable, Melbourne-anchored agency — and you as the strategy-and-execution lead on the campaigns you run.





What you'll do



01 — Strategy. Develop integrated campaign plans spanning SEO, Google Ads,
, and social — paid and organic, across
, Instagram, LinkedIn and other channels. Run competitor analysis and translate findings into campaign opportunities, not slide decks. Articulate strategy, rationale, channels, and expected outcomes in a plan a client can read. Build and maintain content calendars and campaign schedules. Advise on channel mix, sequencing, and budget allocation — and defend your reasoning.



02 — Execution. Set up, monitor, and optimise Google Ads — keyword research, ad copy, audience targeting, bid management. Implement and manage SEO programs — technical audits, on-page optimisation, content briefs, link building. Manage social media accounts — organic posting, community engagement, and paid execution across Meta and LinkedIn. Track performance live and adjust based on data, not on quarterly reviews. Brief copy, creative, and design support when the campaign needs it, and hold the bar.



03 — Reporting & analytics. Build and maintain custom client reporting in Looker Studio. Produce monthly performance reports covering ROI, traffic, conversions, audience growth, and campaign metrics. Use GA4, Google Tag Manager, SEMrush or Ahrefs, and Meta Ads Manager to inform strategy and validate results. Translate numbers into recommendations the client can act on. Flag what isn't working early and propose the change.



04 — Client engagement. Join discovery calls and ongoing client meetings alongside the agency director. Help prepare strategy presentations and campaign proposals for new and existing clients. Walk clients through progress, insights, and recommendations — clearly, in writing and on video. Handle questions and pushback without losing the room. Be the trusted face of the agency on the campaigns you run.





What we're looking for



We're hiring for strategic judgement, execution discipline, and client poise — not a rigid checklist. If most of the below describes you, please apply.



Essential



5+ years hands-on digital marketing experience, preferably in an agency managing multiple client accounts.



Excellent spoken and written English — you'll be on video calls with Australian SME owners and senior marketers, presenting strategy and walking through results.



Proven ability to plan and execute integrated campaigns across SEO, Google Ads, and social (paid and organic).



Strong working knowledge of: Google Ads, GA4, Google Tag Manager, Looker Studio, SEMrush or Ahrefs, Meta Ads Manager, and social scheduling tools.



Track record of building campaign plans that articulate strategy, rationale, channels, and expected outcomes.



Experience translating competitor analysis into actionable campaign moves.



Self-motivated and able to work independently without close supervision.



Reliable home internet and a dedicated, professional home workspace.



Nice to have (not required)



Marketing copywriting — taglines, calls to action, ad copy, social captions.



Familiarity with WordPress for blog posting and basic content updates.



Canva or similar for social media graphics.



 marketing platforms and campaign execution.



Meta advertising compliance, including 18+ ad categories.



Comfort contributing to client-facing meetings and presenting strategy.



Out of scope



Graphic design specialism — the agency has a design team.



Sales and new-business development — the agency director handles client acquisition.



Production-level web development — handled by the build team.





Who you are



You're a strategist who also ships. You can sit on a discovery call with an Australian SME owner, draw the goal out of them, and walk out with a campaign plan you can defend. You like the discipline of Looker Studio more than the noise of vanity metrics. You're comfortable on camera — you can hold the room when a client pushes back, concede what should be conceded, and defend what shouldn't. And you'd rather have a long-term seat at a respected agency than bounce between freelance gigs.



If that sounds like you, we'd love to meet you.





How it works



1. Application review. We assess your resume, portfolio, and answers against the brief. Strong fits move to interview.

2. Interview. A 45-minute video interview with the agency director. We discuss your background, your campaigns, how you work with clients, and how you think about strategy.

3. Paid trial. The strongest candidate is offered a paid initial trial on a probationary basis.





How to Apply



Apply directly via OJP. Attach:



1. Your resume (PDF).

2. Work samples / portfolio — link or PDF. We want to see real campaign work you've run: campaign plans, Looker Studio reports, ad creative, post-campaign write-ups. One strong case study beats a long list.



In your application message, answer these three questions. Short, direct answers — no AI fluff.



1. One campaign, end-to-end. Pick one campaign you owned. Business goal, channel mix (SEO / Google Ads / paid social / organic), what you measured, what the data told you mid-flight, what you changed, and what the campaign actually delivered. 8–12 lines.



2. Client pushback. You're on a video call with an Australian SME owner who disagrees with a recommendation you believe is right. Walk us through a real example — how you held the room, what you conceded, and what you defended.



3. Logistics. Expected full-time monthly salary in PHP, earliest start date, home internet speed, and confirm you can work Melbourne business hours (Mon–Fri).



Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

title: Executive Assistant to the Chief Operating Officer
description:
Please apply on the link below:





What We Offer

- Starting salary of $1,300+/month USD, with room to grow based on demonstrated experience and judgment

- Direct working relationship with the COO of a fast-scaling creator agency; you'll see how senior decisions actually get made

- A role where you're trusted, not micromanaged, trained early, then given your lane to run

- A genuine career-defining seat for an experienced EA, close to the executive table, broad exposure across the business



The Role

Be the Second Brain to a Senior Executive at a Fast-Growing Creator Agency | $1,300+/month | 100% Remote, Philippines.



The COO of this agency is at capacity. He's currently doing all of it himself -- updating trackers, chasing people, drafting documents, building workflows, managing calendar conflicts, thinking through hard conversations alone. Every hour spent on that is an hour not spent on the work only a COO can do. This is the role that fixes that.



We're hiring an Executive Assistant who can absorb the COO's recurring admin and execution load, at high volume, at speed, and to a standard he can trust without checking. You'll own the doing so he can own the d
. This is not a hand-holding role. You'll be trained early, then trusted to run your lane.



The right person for this seat doesn't wait to be told the next step. They take the brief and run. They see the work that needs doing before being asked. And they're the kind of operator a COO can hand something off to and consider it handled.





What You'll Own

- Project and tracker management. Keep all the COO's project trackers and statuses current in Airtable. Maintain visibility on what's moving, what's stuck, and what's due. Nothing falls through.

- Follow-ups and chasing. Own the follow-up loop end-to-end. Chase outstanding items, send the reminders, surface blockers to the COO before they become problems.

- Document drafting. Draft documents the COO would otherwise write himself; to a standard he can route straight for approval without rewriting.

- Workflow builds in ProcessStreet. Build straightforward, repeatable workflows so the COO doesn't have to. Examples: one-off task workflows, leave handoff workflows where leave isn't approved until a handoff plan is filled out and routed.

- Process builds for capacity-constrained department heads. When a department head is buried, build their process for them under the COO's direction. Example: standing up a hiring or onboarding workflow when the owner is buried in interviews.

- Calendar and scheduling. Manage the COO's calendar, resolve meeting overlaps, find times that work across multiple people's schedules.

- Thinking partner. Act as a sounding board on draining or tricky calls. Offer a different angle on how to approach a hard conversation. Handle the legwork of putting things into Claude for the COO.





What You Bring:

Experience (non-negotiable)

- Prior experience as an EA to a senior executive. We want someone who already understands the cadence of supporting an exec at this level; not someone learning it for the first time.

- Comfortable operating at pace across many small parallel tasks. This role is high-volume throughput, not deep specialist work.

Skills (must-have)

- Project and tracker management, hands-on with Airtable

- Strong follow-up discipline; you don't need to be told twice

- Document drafting to a standard a senior executive can route without edits

- ProcessStreet workflow building from a brief

- Calendar management across multiple people's schedules

- Proficient in Claude and AI tools as part of your daily workflow

- Native English



Personality and culture fit (non-negotiable)

- Self-starter. Takes the brief and runs.

- A useful second brain: Offers a different perspective on how to approach a tricky conversation, not just executes the task

- Discreet and trustworthy. You'll see contracts, compensation conversations, and sensitive internal decisions

- Reliable enough that the COO can hand something off and consider it done





Location & Hours

100% remote, based in the Philippines.

Full-time (8 hours/day, 5 days/week) with strong overlap on the COO's working hours.



How You'll Be Measured

- This role is measured on how much load it reliably takes off the COO and how cleanly the work gets done. Specific KPIs and targets are set quarterly with the COO, but the core measures are:

- Task turnaround — speed and reliability on items the COO hands off

- Tracker accuracy and freshness — project trackers stay current, accurate, and trusted as a single source of truth

- Follow-up completion — outstanding items chased to closure, blockers surfaced early

- COO time reclaimed — the headline outcome. How much of the COO's week is freed from admin back into strategic work.

title: [Remote] Senior Paid Acquisition Manager (Google & Meta)
description:
RED. To diagnose a four-month decline in a Google Shopping account before touching any budgets, I would first audit the Google Merchant Center for critical feed diagnostics, checking for recent product disapprovals, price/inventory mismatches, or missing high-intent attributes. Next, I would analyze the competitive landscape using auction insights to see if aggressive new competitors are stealing impression share or pushing up CPCs. Finally, I would break down performance data by product ID in GA4 and Google Ads to pinpoint whether the drop is sitewide or driven by a few previously high-performing hero SKUs losing traction.



FILTER — read first: To prove you read this, start your reply with the word “RED” and answer these three exact questions in your application: (1) How do you test creatives within Meta? (2) What specific experience do you have with clothing or DTC brands? (3) What are your exact decision rules for scaling a winning campaign versus killing a losing one? Applications without the codeword and these answers will be ignored.



We're Anzivota Digital, a global digital marketing agency. This is a strategy and scaling role, not purely an execution or routine management role. We need a high-level specialist who knows how to drive profitable revenue through paid acquisition, maintain strict CAC control, and scale winning campaigns across Meta and Google. If you are a general marketer or content poster, this is not for you. We focus entirely on data, tracking accuracy, and bottom-line spend efficiency.



We need ONE experienced, analytical paid media specialist to take full ownership of our e-commerce client performance. You personally do the work — no agencies, no sub-contracting.



What you'll own (all surfaces, end to end): (1) Campaign Management — daily hands-on management across Meta (CBO, ABO, retargeting) and Google (Search + Shopping), ensuring absolute tracking accuracy across pixels, events, and attribution. (2) Budget Allocation & Scaling — dynamically allocate daily spend based on performance, aggressively scaling winners and cutting underperforming campaigns quickly. (3) Performance Optimization — continuously improve CPA, CAC, ROAS, and CTR through structured A/B testing of creatives and copy using clear, data-backed decision rules rather than vague judgment.



How we work: operate using clear mathematical decision rules (e.g., kill ad sets after $X spend without conversions, scale budgets when CPA is below target for X days, pause creatives when CTR drops below X). One change at a time logged with reasoning, weekly 30-minute review. You must be able to clearly explain how you scale a winning campaign and how you recover a losing one.



Must have: deep ecommerce Google Ads (Search + Shopping) + Meta Ads Manager experience; proven ability to manage budgets based on strict KPI parameters; strong English required. Experience with clothing or DTC brands is highly preferred.



Google Ads, Google Shopping, Meta Ads, Paid Acquisition, Media Buying, CPA, CAC, ROAS, E-commerce, DTC.

title: Lead Generation Expert/Appointment Setter
description:
Summary

We are looking for an experienced Corporate Housing / Direct Booking Outreach Expert to help us generate direct bookings, mid-term stays, corporate housing opportunities, insurance housing leads, relocation stays, and furnished housing contracts for a luxury rental portfolio in Houston, Texas.



This is not a generic VA role.

We are looking for someone who has real experience generating leads, bookings, or contracts for furnished rentals, corporate housing, short-term rentals, mid-term rentals, insurance housing, relocation housing, hotels, or hospitality businesses.



You should know how to find the right companies, reach the right decision makers, create outreach campaigns, follow up consistently, and help move qualified prospects toward actual bookings or housing agreements.



About the Properties



We operate Thompson Luxury Properties, a collection of 4 luxury furnished homes located in Houston, TX 77007.



The homes are fully furnished, professionally designed, and ideal for:



Corporate travelers

Executives

Relocation clients

Insurance housing guests

Medical travelers

Families needing temporary housing

Event groups

Production crews

Extended-stay guests

High-end leisure travelers



The properties are located near major Houston demand drivers, including Downtown Houston, The Heights, Rice Military, Memorial Park, the Galleria, Texas Medical Center, NRG Stadium, universities, law firms, oil and gas companies, medical centers, and corporate offices.



Our goal is to build a reliable direct booking and corporate housing pipeline instead of depending only on Airbnb and other booking platforms.



What We Need



We need someone who can own the outreach process from start to finish.



You will help us identify, contact, follow up with, and convert potential booking sources such as:



Corporate housing managers

Insurance housing / ALE housing contacts

Relocation companies

HR departments

Executive assistants

Hospitals and medical groups

Oil and gas companies

Law firms

Universities

Event planners

Production companies

Sports and entertainment groups

Local businesses with visiting teams, executives, or project-based workers



The goal is to generate qualified conversations that can turn into direct bookings, corporate stays, mid-term rentals, or longer-term furnished housing contracts.



Responsibilities



You will be responsible for:



Building targeted lead lists of companies and decision makers

Finding accurate contact information

Creating
, LinkedIn, and phone outreach campaigns

Writing outreach messages that position the homes properly

Contacting prospects and following up consistently

Tracking every lead, conversation, and follow-up in a CRM or spreadsheet

Booking qualified calls or conversations with interested prospects

Helping move interested leads toward direct bookings or contracts

Coordinating with our team on pricing, availability, and property details

Testing different outreach angles and improving what works

Reporting weekly on outreach activity, replies, leads, calls, and opportunities created



We want someone who can think, execute, follow up, and improve the process without needing to be micromanaged.



Ideal Candidate



You may be a strong fit if you have experience with one or more of the following:



Corporate housing lead generation

Mid-term rental lead generation

Short-term rental direct booking outreach

Furnished rental sales

Relocation housing

Insurance / ALE housing outreach

Hospitality B2B sales

Hotel group sales

Vacation rental direct booking campaigns

Property management lead generation

Executive travel or temporary housing sales



You should understand how to reach decision makers and communicate professionally with companies that can afford premium furnished housing.



Required Skills



You should be strong at:



B2B cold outreach

 outreach

LinkedIn prospecting

Phone follow-up

Lead list building

CRM or spreadsheet tracking

Follow-up discipline

Sales pipeline management

Clear written communication

Booking qualified calls

Understanding premium/luxury positioning

Working independently and moving quickly



Experience with tools like Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, HubSpot, GoHighLevel, Airtable, Google Sheets, Instantly, Smartlead, Lemlist, Clay, or similar tools is a plus.



What Success Looks Like



In the first 30–60 days, we want to see:



A targeted list of corporate, relocation, insurance, medical, and extended-stay prospects

Outreach campaigns actively running

Consistent follow-up with qualified leads

Interested companies entering the pipeline

Qualified calls or booking inquiries generated

Clear weekly reporting on activity and results

Early direct booking or corporate housing opportunities created



The long-term goal is to build a repeatable outreach system that consistently generates direct bookings, corporate housing leads, and furnished rental revenue.



Compensation



Compensation will include a base monthly pay plus performance upside.



We are open to discussing the right structure with the right candidate, but the goal is to create a win-win arrangement where you are rewarded for actual results.



Performance upside may be tied to:



Direct bookings generated

Corporate housing contracts secured

Extended-stay bookings

Qualified opportunities created

Revenue generated from your outreach



We are looking for someone who wants to be invested in the outcome, not just paid for activity.



There is long-term upside for the right person if results are achieved.
